| | | | | | Dear Peter,For many voters across CA-32, ballots have already been cast. If you have already voted, thank you.**For those who have not yet voted, tomorrow is your opportunity to make your voice heard!** I ask for your vote to help defeat incumbent Brad Sherman who has been in office for 31 years. He’s taking money from AIPAC, insurance companies denying fire claims, and special interest groups. He also supports Trump’s tariff policy which is wreaking havoc on our economy and driving up costs for working families. I believe government should work for everyday people—not just those with power, wealth, or special access.Throughout this campaign, I’ve heard from working families struggling in every neighborhood. We must address housing affordability, strengthen public education, defend reproductive freedom, tackle climate change, support small businesses, and create an economy that works for everyone.I believe healthcare should be affordable and accessible. And we must protect Social Security and have Medicare for all. We need comprehensive immigration reform that reflects our values and our humanity.That is the kind of leadership I will bring to Congress.If you have already voted, I ask you to encourage your friends, neighbors, family members, or colleagues to do the same.Together, we can build a future that is more affordable, more just, more inclusive, and more responsive to the people of CA-32.**Thank you for believing in this campaign. Thank you for your support, your energy, and your faith that better leadership is possible.** Let’s finish strong.

But dark money groups have poured over **$3.8 MILLION** into MD-05 to boost my opponents, and my primary election is just **22 DAYS** away.
The pressure is real. Our PUBLIC pre-primary fundraising deadline is in 2 days, and every dollar we don't raise is a voter we can't reach, a door we can't knock, and an ad we can't run in the final stretch of this race.

Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.

Friend,

As we enter the final day before our primary election, I keep coming back to why I’m running for Governor — what’s at stake, and who this campaign is really about.
| | [CHIP IN BEFORE ELECTION DAY TOMORROW](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=2&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)
---
As a 35th-generation New Mexican and proud member of Laguna Pueblo, I am of and for New Mexico through and through.

I know firsthand the struggles too many families are facing — because I’ve lived them. I was a single mother raising my child on food stamps and WIC, working multiple jobs just to get by. At one point, I even cleaned my child’s preschool to help cover tuition. Like so many New Mexicans, I had to make impossible choices — including between rent and groceries — and I built a small business just to gain a little more stability and flexibility.
**[That experience is why I’m in this race: to make life easier for New Mexican families and build a future where our kids can thrive.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=3&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)**

My campaign is about lowering costs, making housing more affordable, strengthening our schools, and addressing the root causes of crime so our communities are safer. New Mexico is already leading in so many ways — from universal childcare to clean energy and our deep cultural traditions — and as Governor, I’ll build on that progress and take it further.
But, if we win tomorrow, it's only the beginning of the hard fight ahead.

Fox News called our race a top pick-up opportunity. One of my possible Republican opponents just put $999,999 of his own money into his campaign. The same donors that elected Trump are funding attack ads filled with lies and misinformation against me, and you can bet that national Republicans will be ready to spend whatever it takes to flip this seat red in November.
**Friend, I’m running for Governor for you — powered by grassroots supporters pitching in $3, $5, $20 when they can. And if I’m going to hit the ground running in the general election, defeat the GOP megadonors, and keep New Mexico blue, I need your help right now to reach my $50,000 pre-primary goal by midnight.**
[**_Please, will you chip in $5 or more now to help fuel our grassroots movement into the general election, win in New Mexico, and build a better future for working families?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=4&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=5&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)

Be Fierce.
— Deb

body:
This campaign was never about me. It was always about what we could build together. | | |
---
| Hi friend, Tomorrow is Election Day, **[and we need all hands on deck to get out the vote!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMe9suWVqtFb-BWoi2l0CARS3P8Bf2LsscfSsEtqZTAyPRn9ciMnAJfBv-B1MiqDypdfJrApRNACELB3pAZ9CvAWvAhXmDT49wWW4svwW7Nv-I_423qwq9HDnMwfaV-PJOJRlSOfNjnRSEO87GFSAXJoaN-vez65b9WxX7pCPBKM0UdjW44s-51aB0tL4rc1Um5qrIGZi2pv3aGX7q8Ap3_gubW4ndn0EXiZ9G93B6Yeq/4r5/dskLfmqARby3LvCDacIHhQ/h0/h001.3qt0pJkbZukp32FSwM9Wo7H5RuDkZdZYm7XuPtNE9Rg)** I hope you’ll join us on the doors or on the phones, but I also wanted to write you one last note. When I decided to run for Congress, I didn't do it because I thought it would be easy. I did it because I believed San Francisco had a chance to lead again. I believed that in a moment when too many politicians were telling people to lower their expectations, we could offer something different: a vision big enough to meet the challenges we face. A vision where housing is affordable. Healthcare is guaranteed. Democracy belongs to people instead of corporations. Technology serves humanity instead of oligarchs. And where our elected officials have the courage to fight for ordinary people instead of powerful interests. Over the last several months, together, we've built the largest field operation in San Francisco history. We've knocked on nearly half a million doors. We've hosted dozens of town halls and events in every corner of the city. We've talked to voters one conversation at a time, one block at a time, one neighbor at a time. **While corporate PACs and Super PACs like AIPAC spent millions trying to buy this election, we built something stronger: trust.** While others relied on consultants, insiders, and establishment endorsements,**we relied on people.** That's what gives me hope. Because no matter what happens tomorrow, this campaign has already demonstrated that people are hungry for a different kind of politics. I've spent much of my adult life trying to help build movements that expand what's politically possible. From Bernie Sanders' campaign, to helping elect AOC and the Squad, to launching the Green New Deal. Every one of those efforts started with people telling us we were being unrealistic. Every one of them succeeded because ordinary people decided to believe in something bigger. This campaign is no different. clean_body: This campaign was never about me. It was always about what we could build together. | | | | Hi friend, Tomorrow is Election Day, I hope you’ll join us on the doors or on the phones, but I also wanted to write you one last note. When I decided to run for Congress, I didn't do it because I thought it would be easy. I did it because I believed San Francisco had a chance to lead again. I believed that in a moment when too many politicians were telling people to lower their expectations, we could offer something different: a vision big enough to meet the challenges we face. A vision where housing is affordable. Healthcare is guaranteed. Democracy belongs to people instead of corporations. Technology serves humanity instead of oligarchs. And where our elected officials have the courage to fight for ordinary people instead of powerful interests. Over the last several months, together, we've built the largest field operation in San Francisco history. We've knocked on nearly half a million doors. We've hosted dozens of town halls and events in every corner of the city. We've talked to voters one conversation at a time, one block at a time, one neighbor at a time. While corporate PACs and Super PACs like AIPAC spent millions trying to buy this election, we built something stronger: trust. While others relied on consultants, insiders, and establishment endorsements,we relied on people. That's what gives me hope. Because no matter what happens tomorrow, this campaign has already demonstrated that people are hungry for a different kind of politics. I've spent much of my adult life trying to help build movements that expand what's politically possible. From Bernie Sanders' campaign, to helping elect AOC and the Squad, to launching the Green New Deal. Every one of those efforts started with people telling us we were being unrealistic. Every one of them succeeded because ordinary people decided to believe in something bigger. This campaign is no different. body:
Two days. National speakers. Rodeo. Fireworks. Back the Blue Bash. Here's what's coming.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sek348431b6)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s7m287a6062)**
| | Peter,
**We're officially 25 days away from Freedom Fest 2026.**
What started as a vision to celebrate Faith, Family, Freedom, and America's 250th Birthday has become one of the most ambitious events we've ever undertaken.
On June 26-27, thousands of patriots will gather at the Douglas County Fairgrounds for two unforgettable days featuring:
🇺🇸 Nationally recognized speakers 🚔 The Back the Blue Bash featuring Dog the Bounty Hunter **🌟** Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Nick Shirley 🤠 A professional rodeo 🎤 Live music and entertainment 📚 Workshops and breakout sessions 🎆 A spectacular drone show finale 🏔 A celebration of Colorado's 150th Birthday
Featured speakers include Greg Gutfeld, Nick Shirley, Lara Logan, Kevin Roberts, Mike Davis, Lee Habeeb, Beverly Aikins, Erin Lee, Dog the Bounty Hunter, and many more.
And we're not done announcing speakers yet. We're announcing _**a member of Trump's cabinet**_ on Friday... you won't want to miss it.
Over the next 25 days, we'll be highlighting different aspects of the event so you can see exactly what makes Freedom Fest unlike anything else happening in America this summer.
If you haven't secured your tickets yet, now is the time. 🎟 GET TICKETS: _**[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s1i9093f3b6)**_
We'll see you in Castle Rock. For Faith. For Family. For Freedom. For the Future.
The RMV Team
---
[FULL WEBSITE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s7k54a84ad6)
|
---
**🎤 FRIDAY MAIN STAGE
**
_****_The opening day of Freedom Festival brings some of the most powerful voices in America to the main stage.
🔹 **Lara Logan** _— Award-winning journalist & former CBS News chief foreign affairs correspondent_
**🔹** **Dr. Kevin Roberts —** _President of the Heritage Foundation_ 🔹 **Beverly Vance Aikin —** _Mother of VP JD Vance, sharing a powerful testimony of faith and redemption_
**🔹** **Mike Davis —** _Conservative lawyer and founder of a project defending constitutionalist judges_
**🔹 Seth Keshel —** _Former Army Intelligence Captain and nationally recognized election analyst_
🔹 **Lee Habeeb —** _Creator and host of Our American Stories_
🔹**Patti Fox** _— Colorado advocate for public safety and victims' rights_
🔹 **Erin Lee —** _Executive Director of Protect Kids Colorado_
🔹 **Pastor Christine Coleman, Heidi Ganahl, Jeff Hunt & more...**
Friday daytime also includes live music, hands-on workshops, and food trucks on-site all day. This is the **Aware · Act · Advocate** experience. You won't just listen — you'll leave with a plan.
[FRIDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s2j6316256e)
|
---
**🚔 FRIDAY EVENING — BACK THE BLUE BASH**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sakdd772c83)
Friday night is a patriotic celebration honoring the men and women who protect our communities.
**Featuring:**
• DOG The Bounty Hunter — Keynote speaker
• Curtis Grimes Band — Breakout Texas country music artist
• District Attorney George Brauchler
• District Attorney Michael Allen
• Pastor Drake Hunter
• Jeff Hunt
• Law enforcement leaders & special guests
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sar11be3a4c) — $95 | [VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s9h8232e385) — $150**
[BACK THE BLUE BASH](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scs3abe6b48)
|
---
**🤠 SATURDAY — RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sbnc37bf073)
Saturday brings something for the whole family.
The rodeo kicks off with real Western action, followed by a Curtis Grimes concert and the Family Fun Fest — completely free for families.
**Family Fun Fest includes:**
• Bouncy Houses
• Petting Zoo
• Face Painting
• Magicians
• Sports Mascots
• Food Trucks & Live Music
**[Rodeo General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sbp8b56f8b3) — $45 | [Rodeo VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/seh37c7360b) — $295** Not into the speakers? This is your perfect Saturday.
[RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/san35d008ea)
|
---
**🎙️ SATURDAY MAIN STAGE**
Saturday afternoon is headlined by one of the biggest names in media today.
🔹 **Greg Gutfeld —** _King of Late Night, host of GUTFELD! — the #1 show in late night, Co-Host of The Five & NYT Bestselling Author_
🔹 **Dr. Robert Malone —** _Original inventor of mRNA vaccine technology and vocal critic of COVID mandates_
🔹 **Dr. James Lindsay —** _Author of Cynical Theories and leading voice exposing woke ideology_
🔹 **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell —** _Delivered the benediction at President Trump's 2025 Inauguration_
🔹 **Data Republican (Jennica Pounds) —** _Software engineer who used AI to expose government waste with DOGE_ __🔹**Jacki & Noelle Caskey —** _Jeffco mother-daughter duo who went viral after Noelle’s middle school banned her pro-life SLAM poem for being "too politically charged"_

Gutfeld is Saturday only. If that's the one name you came for, Saturday daytime is your ticket.
[SATURDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s8q06adaaa2)
|
---
**🌟 SATURDAY EVENING — MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA + DRONE SHOW**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s4u0007ef18)
The weekend ends with a night you won't forget.
The Mountain Majesty Gala is an elegant dinner event featuring some of the most compelling voices of the weekend — capped off with a spectacular drone show finale over Castle Rock.
**Featuring:**
**•** Nick Shirley — Investigative journalist and immigration fraud whistleblower. The journalist they don't want you to watch.
**•** Larry Gatlin — Grammy-winning country and gospel legend
**•** Pastor Lorenzo Sewell
**•** Special guest from Trump's cabinet!
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scub7c5969f)** — $195 | **[VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s0udce8b663)** — $995 | **[VIP + Photo Experience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/seo91f0232b)** — $1,995 (Or included with the [All-Access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s2m45540b90) & [VIP Weekend Pass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scuec28e97e))
[MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s5k047e1bf4)
|
---
**Want to do it all?**
_**America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once.**_

This is the weekend that marks both.
**[GET YOUR TICKET NOW →](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s8rdd3496a8)**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s4t3e23a4d6)
[WEEKEND PASSES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s5m01c7612d)
|

**Interested in Sponsoring?**
This is a unique opportunity for businesses, organizations, and community leaders to align with a major statewide event celebrating freedom, entrepreneurship, and American values.
Sponsors will have the opportunity to: ⭐ Showcase their brand to thousands of attendees ⭐ Connect with Colorado’s most engaged grassroots community ⭐ Be featured across Rocky Mountain Voice’s growing media platform ⭐ Support a historic celebration of our nation and state
Whether you’re a local business, national brand, nonprofit, or community organization, we’d love to explore how you can be part of this historic event.
[SPONSOR FREEDOM FEST](mailto:shanab@madpaxstrategies.com,brielle@goldpeakstrategiesllc.com?subject=Freedom%20Fest%20Sponsorship%20Interest)

We’re a small but mighty team working through an enormous amount of excitement and ticket demand. If you need assistance, please contact us:
**📧[info@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:info@rockymountainvoice.com)**
Thank you for supporting independent media, freedom, faith, family, and the future of Colorado. We cannot wait to celebrate with you in June.

Douglas County Fairgrounds
Castle Rock, Colorado**

| | | We want to take a moment to offer you our heartfelt gratitude. For all the ways you’ve supported Ericka and her campaign for Congress, thank you! With early voting starting this month, our team will be reaching out this week and next to schedule volunteer shifts for the Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. Virtual/remote and in-person canvassing will be available. If you’ve signed up as a volunteer via our website, great! If not, click on the button to volunteer with our campaign.

### Kitchen Table Talks

| | June 14, 11 AM - 12 PM

| [Sign up](https://us.list-manage.com/5Q53e93tBQi?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)

These are opportunities for you to share what you need to see change in DC to create a positive impact in Virginia. Ericka wants to hear what you and your family need right now. Free event; [register](https://us.list-manage.com/16W1phRp26N?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) for the Zoom link.

Come [any time between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM on Saturday, June 7th, and](https://us.list-manage.com/KoCBcQRRZN9?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) [bring your favorite dish to share](https://us.list-manage.com/pr0zHWoPziB?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75).

Due to limited space, registration is required for this outdoor event.

|

### Fun in the sun
---
| [Watch the video](https://us.list-manage.com/ut6nNrOHSXR?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)

| | | After [sharing our excitement](https://us.list-manage.com/LRvz0hBFrdH?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) about submitting the petitions on social, we’re packing our schedule with in-person and virtual events across the district in the weeks to come. Check out our [campaign events](https://us.list-manage.com/y9wBRSXpJDT?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) page to see where you can find Ericka. If you know of an event we should attend or get involved in, let us know by emailing [ekforva@gmail.com](mailto:ekforva@gmail.com).
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
### To VA-1, my family
---
| [Meet Ericka](https://us.list-manage.com/HxLDaXkN_Fx?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)
---
| | | _I’ve lived in the first district for more than 30 years. It is the only home I’ve known. The people of this district raised me into the person I am today; they’re like family. My husband and I chose to stay here because of this inclusive community._
_For years now, this family—my family—has been represented by someone who doesn’t listen to us. Rob Wittman chooses politics over people, corporate money over community. But loyalty to a party isn’t the same thing as leadership._
_We need a leader who listens more than she speaks. Someone who won’t bend the knee to the whims of a madman and his circus of destruction. Someone who has the courage to stand up for the people of this district. I’m running for Congress because my family needs a fighter in their corner to make their needs known in Washington._
_I’m fighting to fight for you._
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
### A people-powered campaign
---

---
| | | Ericka can’t run this campaign without your help. Every dollar you give goes directly to organizing, knocking on doors, and getting her message to voters who are ready for change.
We say NO to:
* Corporate money
* AIPAC money
* Lobbyist money
* Billionaire money
* Predictions markets
* Stocks/trades

We rely on individual donations to meet our campaign needs. No matter the amount you can invest in this campaign, your contribution matters! So if you are tired of being ignored by Washington, chip in now and join the movement to fix it.

# **Indiana has lowest gas prices in the country, governor may extend tax suspension**
[Click Here to Read the Full Story](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhhll-hhlljjcji-y/) WTHI-TV 10
[Ben Verbanic](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhhll-hhlljjcji-j/)
May 28, 2026
[https://www.wthitv.com/news/indiana-has-lowest-gas-prices-in-the-country-governor-may-extend-tax-suspension/article_c5647c49-dfa0-445a-a077-f29cc00c5b2a.html](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhhll-hhlljjcji-t/) Prices at the pump have skyrocketed since the US-Israeli conflict with Iran began.
Brandon Bell/Getty Images via CNN Newsource Indiana pump prices are the lowest in the country according to a report from GasBuddy.This comes after Gov. Mike Braun suspended two major gas taxes, and he says he might extend the suspension again.According to GasBuddy, the national average price for gas sits at around $4.45 per gallon. This price is up about $1.32 from last year.However, the Hoosier State is sitting well below that price, at just $3.90 per gallon -- the cheapest in the country. This comes after Braun suspended the gasoline usage and excise taxes."Many states could not do this because they are not run very well, the economic growth is not there," Braun said. "The good news is we are getting a dividend by running state government more efficiently in the year and a half I have been here, and we have the best economic growth in decades."Braun says that cutting costs and juicing revenue made addressing pump price sticker shock an easy decision."It's been good that legislators have been behind me on that. It was my option to do it," Braun said. "And I feel so good about the state's future, how we are running state government, that it was a simple gesture for Hoosiers."The tax suspensions are set to expire in June."Hoosiers deserve a break, and I will look at it again in early June, because there is nothing more pleasing to me than Indiana having the lowest gas prices in the entire country," Braun said. name: Rep. Gloria Johnson
subject: A Fight Worth Having
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
Meet my friend Corbin, I think many of you will be interested in his work

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c76df59e23de/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363639?e=dc5f639d62)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
|
---
| |

Hey y'all,Gloria Johnson is letting me write to you because she knows what we're building, and she wants you to know about it.
My name's Corbin Trent. I'm a Tennessean. I worked for Bernie Sanders, helped run Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's first campaign and her congressional office, and co-founded Justice Democrats and Brand New Congress.
Now I'm building the next thing.
It's called **A Fight Worth Having**.
[**Watch the video and get the names early.**](https://us.list-manage.com/_BrErq694bn?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
Not because you need another email in your inbox. Nobody does.
Because I'm going to tell you about the candidates worth knowing before the party tells you they're viable. The races where early support can change the outcome. The fights that matter before they become obvious. And the ideas that can actually make people's lives better — from housing to health care to the cost of living.
Over 110,000 people already subscribe to my writing. The PAC is what happens when you stop just writing about the problem and start backing the people who can fix it.
Here's why I'm writing to _you_.
Tennessee tells the national story in miniature. This is a state Democrats used to win. A state Democrats helped build — the TVA, Oak Ridge, Rural Electrification, the Interstate Highway System. My grandfather worked for the TVA. I've got uncles who built the interstate and worked at the lab. Most families here have a story like that, one generation back or two.
Then the national party stopped building. It started managing. It started apologizing. It turned its back on working people and chased Wall Street. And it wondered why a state that was once the proudest example of what Democrats could do for working people stopped voting for them.
Three weeks ago, the Tennessee legislature carved up Steve Cohen's District 9 in Memphis like a Thanksgiving turkey — splitting Shelby County across three Republican districts and ending the career of the last Democrat in our congressional delegation. They did the same thing to Jim Cooper's District 5 in Nashville in 2022. Justin Pearson, who was running against Cohen in the primary, has relaunched in the redrawn 9th. He's exactly the kind of candidate we should be backing.
[**Find out who's worth fighting for.**](https://us.list-manage.com/mCkh8g44tMs?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
Tennessee is not a lost cause. It is a warning. What's happening here is happening everywhere, and it won't stop until we build the infrastructure to fight it.
That's why one of the first things we're pushing for is reform you can explain to your neighbor in one sentence: districts drawn by math, not by politicians. Take the maps out of the hands of state legislatures. Make them transparent, neutral, and verifiable. Most Americans across the political spectrum can already see this is the logical solution. We just need a movement loud enough to demand it.
**A Fight Worth Having** is not a normal Democratic operation. We're going back to what was best in the FDR tradition — the building, the public investment, the standing up to concentrated wealth — and leaving behind what was worst, the racism and the xenophobia. We're building a new kind of Democrat: one with pride in their work, one who builds instead of takes, one who refuses corporate PAC money and isn't afraid to take on Democratic leadership when leadership is wrong.
We're recruiting candidates across the country who fight for that, and for the kind of public investment that built Tennessee the first time around.That's the project. Not another newsletter for the sake of a newsletter. A way to connect people who are tired of watching the party lose winnable fights to candidates and ideas worth fighting for.
[**Get the names early at AFightWorthHaving.com.**](https://us.list-manage.com/WLOnbPXYXWJ?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
I'll send you the candidates worth watching. The races where your attention matters. The arguments we need to win. The places where a little money, pressure, or momentum can change what happens next.
If you showed up for Gloria, you've already proven you'll fight for something better. Stay in the fight.
[**Watch the video and get the next names.**](https://us.list-manage.com/RXqIXr2OfdR?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
Yours, Corbin Trent
P.S. — Gloria didn't ask me to say this, but she's one of the steadiest, most decent people I've worked with in politics. Tennessee is lucky to have her.

## Trump Unfazed as Iran Suspends Talks
Iran's state media said Monday that Tehran is suspending talks with the U.S. over Israel's [offensive in Lebanon](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1y6yAUhJ8GdWgQf5ILituo821TarA5WCdB4MCxNc7TZ-RXSLPNznw7336cl7PHhPn232_gKJYlw94SEEFdsPpMPn01zN8PaIQl76Wm0BYppOXCciGX4DG9Ft0FFwEkqA7cME5CnfQ0mm51yo8nry82GGujEira0Xilo40BpNZDh-6gCSvkIMRoVK9gUsrEyYD2p0EapgUEpFL7z4KZVojpVZ5Q-2vZuuRWontj6h-TM5Pzvu_9NV-uR8nkfKCZnMU7Bibnw4k_Gs9wK4T-cGq8UfVIvES-lro9fvqVttRVF-47poTNjkyL2-YxvTfpT0c9nfwNAAD__7qKfBA), and warned it could move to close the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump said Iranian officials didn't warn him of any change in negotiations and wasn't worried, telling [reporters](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAQhp_G3rAIGBsPDF2ypWtH64AjuYZACiRW3r5y1DfodNL90q_v-79O6wkoUjp_wg1NC3lNuNWIrWFZqUBqEK-V0s8Da6Octlyir6vgYmJ8YlysHii-1rH3JiAKlD2aw6y5XEY9q_5ipNAWgkDt0Afn5sUCd1Z5izb4sMiezN7GJy4OnM9KDhK1lCpohSMsB6G6kaOnlsvwnSm1C4b4yk8sg8u3PppLa_fayY9OHDtx3LZtSNbtFnu-f3bkThx3m7_D6qPeMfnK3nrsURnVAhgZtAbuWllECyknVlwCOc56Un0x_r5RjFSnuRv5-QYU3wjtX7s9jfgNAAD__20ChP4), _"If they don't want to talk, that's OK with me."_ Oil jumped more than $6 a barrel. Hours later, Trump posted on Truth Social that Israel and [Hezbollah had agreed to stop fighting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0Dtu6zAQheHVSJ2N4fAhuWBxgQt1ThUgpTAWhxYTilRI2oZ3HzhbSHsO8BX_x3k-U4ghXd9oY9t8nhM_auTWuMyhUGoUv2pI3zeuLeT0yCW6OiOgOYA5AM6OQnzOqnfWMyPLnq0YRpAnNQ66Xy36UQuNvIy00HIhc0GS3pG7MIPxqg_2pYEBFACDlkfJo5Taj5oVnQTqTgG70HI5fuaQ2so-PvOdy3HJWx_t2tpeO_mvw6nDqZVbW2teAsXX_xoVFKb4PyeK7r3ctr3Dac-11Q4nIYwZDEgF6mSEkiD6Yt3-CDGGaoZOwXWj8Ev17U997hZ_AgAA__-aCXjH) after his calls, and that no Israeli troops would enter Beirut. He added that talks with Iran were [actually "continuing, at a rapid pace](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u8yAUxvGrgS3R8eEzA8MrvfKWTpU6WiQcx7QYXCCJcveVewtdn0f6Df-P83T2McV8e_MruT6XKdOzJeqd6hSrz92nrxbz951ajyU_S02hTQioD6APgFPwMb0myYObiZAEJzcYC-IkrVF8cZ4ItMWgQV4UgBImaBoEzvZ0uQQteXS7BhpwADBKHAVZIdRsFUl_GlAxCRRiL_X4WWLuC83pVR5Uj9ey8uSW3rfGxD-GI8Ox13tfWrlGn_Z_HyVU8ul_yT6F93pfN4bjVlpvDMdh0NposEZKBcagEry6sD1jSrFpwyTcVh9_Kd7_1Ofh8CcAAP__OMB3ZA)," capping a chaotic day in the three-month war.
## Florida Sues ChatGPT Maker OpenAI
Florida sued ChatGPT maker OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, on Monday, accusing the company of [prioritizing profit over safety](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL_OnDAQxJ8GOiNjm3-FizR0lzYl2sPrYxNjE3vvEG8fEX1v8FUjzUijmd-vx_IAChRfP2FHyz4tEc8SkBnzQhkiQ_hTKP59Y2FK8Uw5uLIoqXoheyHV4oDCtZjaWY-oUNdo22GUejLj0NWbVa17TvjsnZbYTX4wuKpp8B4nA633XU32bpO9VK2UQ6cbjaPWnR87NDC1qquMREeccvM7UeQNfbjSB3Ozpr0OdmM-SqV_VGqu1HyeZxOf6_3izis1M67bl4jbrtTsQ8rkQJQ3FpEOjECiwC4g8A5RFLgovsTxZnHk5IlFAY98ibxG0GbopaqzdcdJIVDph8rI1w4U_g_ib1H8WPUvAAD__628iQ4) and of pushing a product it knew could harm users. The suit claims ChatGPT [aided and abetted mass shooters](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfg7dYl8PYeGDo4i1dO1rEHMmlxKRATdJfX7l_oduTnvRJ732c5pPlwOvl3d7JFB_nlWoOVAqlmZNdiw2fmdevb8qF41pjCi7PCNgfoD8Azs5yeM1d44wnQpINmeOgQY6dHlRzNaMbSQ1S20FBT70n8J1DVF5rC6DGhs2uQQ94BBiUbCVpKZXXijo7HlGJDshxiam9RV7LlXx4xY1Su8R7E8y1lEcW8k3gJHCqtbbn87J3Aqd9jMDJpsJLoD0uP0-8waYdPmOTjHtUDoFzP4gOLnfL4U8t_7piM_gbAAD__1kecjc), alleging the Florida State University gunman consulted it about firearms and campus locations before an attack that killed two. It's the first such state lawsuit and seeks to hold [Altman personally liable](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvgzAQBeBfYzaQOWwgg4cubOnaEV3wEa497BQ7sfLvq-QvdHnLk74nva_zfEYWDtdP3MnlNc6BShLKmY6ZDwwZ5Sdx-L1TyhxDiYf4NIOGvtZ9rWH2yPKcTeXdSgTUVeTaYdTdyYyDrTY3XmwPYPFihsVY7Zdx8ab13oA2Fheq2L003WtotR5s13Q0dp1dR0sGTy1YZTR5zvFoviOHvNEqz_igo1niXonbcr4l1X0omBRMpZRmCZflVSqYXrSCSb-jVTCtEg_2WOO1jjcKNXKNkncMtWBJd87NlnepDudvhUU49YMy-rojy3sv_-ukh4O_AAAA___PnHpP). A number of other families have also sued, tying the chatbot to suicides and delusions. It lands as a new study finds [one in five young people](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtyrDAQheHVQCZKD4QgUHATsrmpQ6oLNdC2kMZSz1Cze9d4C97AOfX9H7flBhQp7f_hRM9bXhJeNSIzloUKJIb4VSl9P7Ay5XTlEkNdtNSDkIOQeglA8bX0bfAbokbToldulGbqR2fbw1sEAyooN6GRo7YONoXb5EA5PckeW_LvNTlIraR01nQGR2PsNlrsYVLaNr3EQJxL95kp8YFbfOUnlm7NZxv9wXyvjfnX6LnR83VdXV0J04pvSZfL3ugZCtMasdEzI6YqXvmRdgHhEbmKE99KcSBEPgRQW3y4XxQj1cE1vdxPoPh7xn8q9PT6JwAA___ncnwz), about 8 million, lean on chatbots for mental health advice.
## List: World's Largest Armies
The world's largest army in 2026 isn't China, Russia, or the U.S. It's Bangladesh, which tops a [new ranking](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGy4yAQRE-DMlQIhIQDgk2UedMNVWMx2LNG4IWxVb79lv8_ws-7uvu9P-f1DJQoX3_Djp5jWTMeLSEz1pUqZIZ0b5T_PbExlXyUmkJbtdKTVJNUeg1A6b2OXfARUaPp0A-zU-Y0utl2N-9m5_Rl2txpu0wRL1HBoEcDNlqwc4CO_KdNTUoPSs3W9AadMTY6iyOcBm3FqDAQl9r_LZT5hjG9ywtrv5W9S_7G_GjC_BJ6EXo5jqN_UXtC2uBBDIkaf4JCLxXyHYP8RpAJ6hUbS6g7YZOU5eeG0EtXfXgclBK1aRajuu5A6WuLfyTo5fX_AAAA__-7YHuM) of total military personnel with about 7 million. The catch is that Bangladesh fields only around 204,000 active troops. Its No. 1 spot comes almost entirely from a vast network of [reserves and paramilitary forces](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyqzAQheGngc7MspIAFypu4863TcmszWI2WSQiFGt4-0ycR0h5Zs58xf92Ha8kKuHxn1b2eY5j4LIr58xplEQhk37sEj6_eM8SQ4lJp31EwO4E3QlwnEj0GG09-ZkZ2dTs234Ac7ZD7-rFcwcOAO93cm5CA-1siW9sDDmLXd_X4n806ABbgN6ZxvBgjJsHx5bOLbrKAk-SY2reo4S88KxHfHJq7nGt1S85b3tl_lV4qfBSSmkeGm-ksyTeYvn9VXhZKbzmaaNEq6hkSkezLVud_LQVUZW96ysLj5VEX3j-U5Gnx-8AAAD__3gUdtg). Vietnam ranks second, and war-torn [Ukraine third](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvgzAQBeBfgzeQOdtgDx66sKVrR2TBEa41dmpfgvLvq-QvdHx60ie993WZL4EipetnONDzlueEZ43IjGWmEhKH-FMp_d6xMuV05hLXOoOEoZVDK2FeA8XnrMXqN0RAJdD3o5XKaTsasXu7uK3fBliVczroxcC4YG8kWCkdDCjIvzQ5SOilHI3qFFqlzGYN6uB6MI2WuBLn0n1nSrzjFp_5gaVb8iGi35lvtVEfDUwNTOd5diHHV9fAFArTErE2MC35nrgQ1jaGcsXKbSjHK7639GCMNs5Ct_MRRfHr7aQYqQ5jo-X1CPQmBf_ro4eHvwAAAP__aiR58g), both built on huge reserve systems rather than large standing armies. Counting only active-duty troops flips the list: China leads with roughly 2 million, followed by India, Russia, and the U.S., which still holds the world's largest defense budget. [Here's the full ranking of national armies](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGy4yAQRE-DMlQIhIQDgk2UedMNVWMx2LNG4IWxVb79lv8_ws-7uvu9P-f1DJQoX3_Djp5jWTMeLSEz1pUqZIZ0b5T_PbExlXyUmkJbtdKTVJNUeg1A6b2OXfARUaPp0A-zU-Y0utl2N-9m5_Rl2txpu0wRL1HBoEcDNlqwc4CO_KdNTUoPSs3W9AadMTY6iyOcBm3FqDAQl9r_LZT5hjG9ywtrv5W9S_7G_GjC_BJ6EXo5jqN_UXtC2uBBDIkaf4JCLxXyHYP8RpAJ6hUbS6g7YZOU5eeG0EtXfXgclBK1aRajuu5A6WuLfyTo5fX_AAAA__-7YHuM).

Currently, there are no vacancies on the Supreme Court. But make no mistake: the knives are already out.

| Conservative judges across the country are writing increasingly unhinged opinions designed to catch Trump's eye, signaling their loyalty before a seat even opens. One opened a dissent with a crude term for male genitalia. Another reversed his long-held position on birthright citizenship almost overnight.
These judges are competing for a lifetime appointment, and whoever wins will sit on that court for decades. This is the endgame. Trump replaces three older justices on the court with younger extremists, and liberals are locked out of the Supreme Court for an entire generation. This is how Trump's America becomes permanent.
The only way out of this nightmare is to expand and rebalance the court, and it does not require a constitutional amendment, just a law passed by Congress. That means Democrats must take back the House, Senate, and White House by 2028 and have the courage to act.
That is what our Unpack Our Courts initiative is building. But we cannot wait until 2028 to fight. This November we are protecting state Supreme Courts in Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota and backing Democrats in critical races while we build the national movement for federal reform. Every piece of this fight is connected and every race matters.
Over 100,000 Democrats have already joined our fight. We are building the infrastructure to reform the court right now, while there is still time to stop this. ## Preparing for Hurricane Season
The Atlantic hurricane season officially opened yesterday, with the potential to impact 367 miles of Texas Gulf coastline. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) [is forecasting below-normal activity](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd0T82YkLim3c3W23tA7mEKNgsOAkTt5-5bzCrUea-eb79zP_QEwx3__ChpbeocwZj5aQCOu8J8iFyt5CqQG2mCK2Ft8hzUqogYuBCzV7iOkzm85bJ_woO7TyehN6vMlb3602BNUP3vVmGHvXA_bayGWRxjgNYXC6i_YsE4NQUgotzEX2V9TG44jKBacVMwJ9pFIvtCLhG1pIn_LCelnK1iW7Eu2N6T9MTUxNj-C3M2BqOp8wNaWyQGJqWp-1xgUy8obQSuYO7zE3TsXDhx8rEG_lSStCI_7d4W0tz-T5I5eDh1L5SdpV6_cjphTbcGVG3DeI6YtCvxP4sup_AAAA__9g4YfL) for the season, with 8 to 14 named storms and 1 to 3 major hurricanes, well below historical averages. The Colorado State University's hurricane group agrees, citing El Niño-driven wind shear that tends to weaken storms before they can intensify over the tropical Atlantic. However, a quiet basin-wide forecast does not project where storms will go. NOAA has been clear that landfall location can't be predicted months out, and one direct hit can make any season catastrophic for the community in its path. Experts have urged Southeast Texans to [use this early window](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2yrCAQhJ8GM6xhFFcDgpuY7U1PaMEyrFOFYgH79_an1lc4SYfdX38_1-VqOfJ-_283MvUd0rLTq0SqlfJyRLunmo4SUg5248hUCr9DXBBwkDBIwMVbjp-lb7xx4CfVkFGXEbppVKNuVuNG0B5tGAbd0TQpDVrhDRwGp8eeQsPmWwYDoFLQQd8qfaGu9zQRuuA6FD2Q55pyW1eq9LYlxE96Um5vaWuiWWs9iuj-CZwFzl_89m7jk0pNe1vt9mjJPwTO3xmBM5yhBM6O5JHpsJm8PA-tj5z5ZneShWxJu-QiV8okcG6y8ceLY-QyXEQP981yPAHq37Q9Df4GAAD___jrgHE) to review evacuation zones, stock a hurricane kit, and check flood insurance coverage.

It's Primary Day, Peter!

First: **[Polls are open from 7 AM to 8 PM. Double-check your polling place HERE to make sure you're ready to vote!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132530228/624856455/-729801472?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDRlYzk1Ny03NDVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ur_OgjYGq2o9Uir_i0abxEsI5h7qSG_fWIJO5CGFM90=&emci=6d8b4ca3-d85d-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=c44ec957-745e-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=13891890)**

Since launching this campaign last summer, our team has traveled across the district sharing Christina's vision for Iowa's future and listening to what people want from their representative. Again and again, we've heard the same thing from voters: they're ready for change, and want leadership grounded in the needs of Iowans, not Washington insiders.

Peter,
If you’re anything like me, just turning on the news can feel exhausting. Even when you think it couldn’t get worse...there’s something that surprises you.
This is on purpose. And it’s exactly what the president wants. Let me explain.
The price of gas and groceries is soaring. Insurance premiums are sky-high. Trump’s approval rating is underwater, including in Florida.
With the election around the corner, he’s getting desperate. So, what does he do?
He distracts.
He starts a war in Iran with no clear idea how it ends. He fires his administration officials, who’ve spent months covering up his scandals. He attacks his enemies on social media.
By flooding you with never-ending news, he hopes to distract you from what’s actually going on. But we can’t forget.
Not when it costs you more to fill up your car with gas.
Not when he gave massive tax cuts to his billionaire friends, and passed on those costs to you.
Not when his allies, like my opponent Ashley Moody, traded more than $2 million in corporate stock last year — while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
Donald Trump and his allies are rigging the system for themselves. We cannot let their games win.
I am running for the United States Senate because the people of Florida deserve a Senator who is focused on ending the chaos, crushing corruption, and cutting costs — not being a rubber-stamp for the MAGA agenda.
The Senate hinges on my race in Florida. I can win this race and deliver Democratic power to check an out-of-control administration, but I can’t do it alone.

| |
---
|
---

This is an important opportunity to highlight how healthcare worker vaccine mandates contribute to that shortage. Closing the loopholes in **Texas law that****still allow healthcare worker vaccine mandates** is one of our top priorities for the 2027 Legislative Session. Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. body:
It’s Election Day! Putting on my teacher hat for a second: do you know why we vote on Tuesdays?

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/6DEotGDlsD3?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
| | | | | | Peter,
It’s Election Day!
Putting on my teacher hat for a second: do you know why we vote on Tuesdays? Back in the 1800s, America was a largely rural country, and many people had to travel a significant distance to get to their polling place. Congress wanted a day that worked for farmers and churchgoers, so Sunday was out because of church, Monday could be used for travel, and Wednesday was often market day where farmers sold their crops. So Tuesday became Election Day.
Ok, back to our regularly scheduled programming.
This has been a truly gratifying campaign as we’ve had the chance to connect to thousands of voters and share our priorities for L.A. Unified. Getting **cell phones off campuses** , **reducing screen time** in classrooms, **greening campuses** and **raising staff pay** : these are not just talking points, but very real for students, parents, teachers, and families.
As we reach the finish line, we remain grateful for your continued support. [Any extra donations will be put into helping us reach voters in these final hours.](https://us.list-manage.com/Inq281LFhjx?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
The biggest way you can help is to volunteer for our final Election Day outreach. We are hosting a virtual phone bank at 4 PM, which you can register for [here](https://us.list-manage.com/HOImIlbu8ng?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba). We’ll be making calls until polls close, and we’d love to have you there!
Thank you for your support. **Let’s win this thing tonight!**

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: CompareMySchool.com – Giving Parents Real Information About Their Schools
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/usnationaldebt-12853520?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,
Something important happened this week.

In the Clarion-Ledger - the largest newspaper in the Magnolia State - we launched a new tool that lets every Mississippi parent see, in one place and in plain English, how their local school is actually doing.

It is called CompareMySchool.com. You can visit it by clicking the image below.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/sh5K3fmHy9v?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
| Mississippi families ought to be able to see for themselves exactly how their school stacks up. Not buried in a government PDF. Not gated behind a login. Not filtered through a press release. Just there — free, public, searchable.

So we built it.

We pulled together every piece of publicly available data on every school in the state and put it into a format ordinary families can actually use. Type in your school. Up it comes. For the first time, you can see:
* How your local school is really performing.
* How your child is doing — against other students in their school, their district, the state, and the rest of America.
* How much your district spends per child — and how that compares with what nearby private schools charge in tuition.

That last point is worth pausing on. In a number of Mississippi districts, the per-student spend is higher than what a local private school charges per pupil. That is the sort of fact that, once seen, cannot be unseen.

Please do three small things this week:
1. Visit CompareMySchool.com and look up the school nearest you.
2. Share what you find with one parent, grandparent, or pastor you know in Mississippi.
3. Forward this email to a friend.

None of this would be possible without you. Thank you, as always, for caring about Mississippi.
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy

In Coweta County, Georgia, a young woman named Ansley Brown is watching her family home of more than twenty years get marked for a bulldozer.
Her home is not blocking a flood-control project. It is not standing in the way of a public road. It is in the path of a high-voltage transmission line Georgia Power wants to build to serve a massive private data center campus called Project Sail. Her family was told that if they did not settle on a price, Georgia Power could go to court and let a jury decide the value of the home they never wanted to sell.
Her family is not alone. Dozens of homes may be demolished, and more than 330 private properties are affected.
That is eminent domain in 2026. It is also theft.
If the government can take your land whenever someone more powerful wants it, then ownership is conditional, and conditional ownership is not ownership at all. If you cannot say no, it is not yours.
Some will say this view is too absolute. They will say roads will not be built, schools will not be constructed, and progress will stop if government loses the power to seize private land. That is a lie.
If a project is genuinely valuable, then the people who want to build it should pay enough to convince owners to sell. If they cannot, they should change the route, move the project, wait, or offer more. That is how free people deal with one another.
Walt Disney bought roughly 27,000 acres in Central Florida in the 1960s through voluntary transactions without taking a single acre by force. Private developers still assemble land every day for shopping centers, subdivisions, industrial parks, and major projects without forcing unwilling owners off their property. The claim that nothing can be built without eminent domain is not a fact. It is an excuse to avoid paying the real price.
Mississippi already understood this. In 2011, voters approved Initiative 31 by a landslide, 73 percent to 27 percent. The amendment barred the state and local governments from taking private property and transferring it to another private party for ten years after the seizure. The Mississippi Farm Bureau Federation led the fight. Governor Haley Barbour opposed it. The people won anyway.
But we left a hole.
Initiative 31 included an exception for "common carriers and utilities." At the time, many voters likely understood "utility" to mean the power company serving the public. They did not imagine a utility using eminent domain to build a high-voltage corridor whose practical purpose is to serve one private data center. That loophole was written for one world. It is now being used in another.
This matters in Mississippi. Entergy and Mississippi Power both have legal authority to use eminent domain for transmission lines. I have seen no public reporting that either has threatened to use that power against a Mississippi landowner for a data center project. But the authority exists, and the pressure is growing. Mississippi is already seeing major data center development, including AWS-related transmission in Madison and Warren counties, Compass Data Centers in Meridian, and xAI in Southaven.
At some point, a utility may be tempted to use eminent domain to clear the way for infrastructure serving a private data center. Whether that happens should not depend on corporate goodwill. The power should not exist.
If Mississippi utilities ever use eminent domain against a farmer or homeowner to build a transmission line for a hyperscale data center, it will be no different in principle from what happened to Susette Kelo in New London or what is happening to Ansley Brown in Georgia. The state will be taking someone's land for someone else's profit.
The fix is simple. Mississippi voters should amend the Constitution again. This time, no loopholes. No exceptions. If a road, school, transmission line, or private development cannot be built without taking someone's land by force, then the project should move, bend, wait, or pay enough to earn a voluntary yes.
A forced sale is not a free transaction.
My land is my land. The State of Mississippi is not my landlord. The Public Service Commission is not my landlord. Entergy is not my landlord. County supervisors are not my landlord.
Pay my price, change your plans, or go around.
But stealing my land is never OK.

subject: Summer is when we hunt. June is when we run out of money.
body:
Match the $48k by June 15 and we get the entire summer.
Match the $48k by June 15 and we get the entire summer.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7478991/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvOVFzckhqQjU2Rw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MDI/LbmNsOGE2UzF4Rw/qP2hpZHM9bmNna0JTUWpXU1oxa2Rscw/gah7Y7A/s4mda34ed23)

| [ ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Dear Patriot,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)Summer is when O'Keefe Media Group does its best work. It is when senators leave Washington and start talking. It is when federal employees clock out at 4 p.m. and answer their phones at bars. It is when defense contractors take meetings in steakhouses, when teachers get loose at conferences, when state election officials get sloppy. The legacy media is at the beach. The agencies run on skeleton crews. The targets we have been working on for months — quietly, patiently — finally drop their guard. Summer is also when the donations stop. [**We need your support**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.). Americans have other things to spend money on in June, July, and August. Vacations. Camps. Property taxes. I understand. But for this organization, the calendar is the opposite of the bank account — the most productive months of the year are also the months we have to scrape to stay in the field. A longtime donor of OMG knows this too. And this morning, he did something about it. **He put $48,000 on the table — and told me he will match every dollar OMG raises between June 1 and June 15, up to that full amount.[**Will you chip in?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** If we hit $48,000 in the first half of June, he doubles it. That is $96,000 — every operational expense for the month of June, covered in full, with the entire summer freed up to do what we do best. If we miss it, the match disappears. [**Every donation still helps**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.). But the doubling is gone. [**▶ DOUBLE YOUR GIFT — MATCH ENDS JUNE 15**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Here is what your matched dollar pays for between now and Labor Day: Investigations we have been building for months that are nearly ready to release. Field journalists wired up and walking into rooms with people they have spent the spring earning trust from. Legal review on three pieces of footage right now that involve named federal employees. Editors working late to splice testimony admissions against the public denials those same people made on the record. This is not theoretical. This is the calendar I am looking at on my desk right now. [**You're the missing link that makes it happen.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) The people I am about to expose do not know what is coming. The institutions they work for do not know what is coming. The legacy press will not touch any of it. **We will.** [**If you fund it.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) [****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[**CHIP IN — EVERY DOLLAR DOUBLED →**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** I will not insult you by listing dollar amounts and pretending I know what each one buys. You already know what you can give. What I will tell you is that the match is real, the deadline is real, **and the work is real.** June 15. Midnight. [**Every dollar matched until then**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.).
In Truth,James O'Keefe Founder, O'Keefe Media Group
P.S. ****There is a man, right now, sitting at a desk in a federal building in Washington, D.C., who has no idea that a woman he had lunch with three weeks ago was wearing a wire. He will find out on YouTube.[**Help us pay for the release.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) [**▶ MATCH MY GIFT BEFORE JUNE 15**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Alexandria, VA 22314

subject: I’m taking a leap of faith
body:
I am no stranger to tough fights, but right now, I’m worried.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1618%2E124072%2EkGnCtE)
| | | |
---
Peter, I have an urgent update:
With news coming out a few weeks ago that a second GOP super PAC is committing nearly $20 million to attacking me – bringing their total up to almost $100 million – I just took a leap of faith:
**I made the decision to start running our first TV ad of the cycle earlier than planned – even though we do not have the money in our budget for it yet.**
**_[Before I explain further, will you chip in $5 now to help us close the gap?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12666?amount=5&t=8&akid=1618%2E124072%2EkGnCtE)_**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12666?amount=5&t=9&akid=1618%2E124072%2EkGnCtE)
---
I am no stranger to tough fights, but right now, I’m concerned.
With Politico reporting that Democrats have no chance at winning back the Senate without flipping North Carolina blue, all of this new super PAC money could tip the scales. Experts are now predicting that this will be the most expensive Senate race in history.
**I’m facing an onslaught of Republican attack ads, and they are starting to work as planned:** A recent poll shows this race statistically tied, and The Wall Street Journal’s latest ranking marks our race a “Toss Up.”
That’s why I made the decision to go up with ads of our own – because unless we fight back now, we risk our message getting drowned out at a critical moment.
**_[Please, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help us keep our ads on the air, reach North Carolinians with the truth about our campaign and win this toss-up race?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12666?amount=5&t=10&akid=1618%2E124072%2EkGnCtE)_**

Thank you,

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Research Boulevard ---|--- • | Awesomely • | Immersed | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Celebrating Pride – and fighting for what comes next
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
During Pride Month I’ve been reflecting on how far we’ve come in the fight for equality – and how important it is that we keep electing leaders who will continue moving our country forward.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_1.a7MA3R&refcode=em20260602-1&t=1&akid=6968%2E582294%2EF8yod2)
Hi,
It’s Tammy Baldwin, U.S. Senator from Wisconsin.
During Pride Month I’ve been reflecting on how far we’ve come in the fight for equality – and how important it is that we keep electing leaders who will continue moving our country forward.
**That’s why I’m proud to support Chris Pappas in his campaign for the U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.**
If elected Chris would become the first out gay man elected to the United States Senate. And I know he’d bring to this job the same commitment I’ve always tried to bring to mine: fighting to make sure every person is treated with dignity and has a fair shot to get ahead.
**[Before I go any further, will you chip in $5 to support Chris’s campaign today?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_1.a7MA3R&refcode=em20260602-1&t=2&akid=6968%2E582294%2EF8yod2)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_1.a7MA3R&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-1&t=3&akid=6968%2E582294%2EF8yod2)**
When I was elected as the first openly gay member of the United States Senate, I understood how important representation could be. Not because making history is the end goal, but because it matters who has a seat at the table.
**Chris understands that responsibility.**
In Congress he’s worked to lower prescription drug costs, support small businesses, protect access to health care, and stand up for New Hampshire families. He’s a thoughtful, hardworking leader who never loses sight of the people he serves.
_And now he’s running in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country._
Pride Month is a time to celebrate progress, but also to remember that none of this happened by accident. Every step forward came because people organized, spoke out, and elected leaders who were willing to fight for equality and opportunity for all.
**That work is as important now as it has ever been. So I’m asking:[Will you make a donation of $5 or whatever you can today to help Chris Pappas win this critical Senate race and keep New Hampshire blue?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_1.a7MA3R&refcode=em20260602-1&t=4&akid=6968%2E582294%2EF8yod2)**

Thanks for being part of this fight.
Tammy Baldwin
U.S. Senator from Wisconsin
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260602-1&t=24&refcode2=6968_582294_F8yod2&akid=6968%2E582294%2EF8yod2)**

Right now, my opponents are spending _every last dollar they can_ to buy this race and convince New Mexican voters to elect them so they can bring their extremist agenda into our state — raising costs, rolling back voting rights, and more.

** _We can't let them win._**
I believe every New Mexican deserves to know their voice matters and that their needs are reflected in the decisions shaping our state.

I have experienced firsthand the very challenges I’m ready to take on: affordability, access to healthcare, safer communities, and affordable housing. That’s why I know how much of a difference it would make to give New Mexicans a raise, invest in New Mexico agriculture to bring more local food to grocery stores, ban AI from setting rent prices, help our children read earlier, and bring the trades back into schools starting as early as middle school. **I’m in this fight to listen to our communities and keep fighting for the people who don’t always have a seat at the table.**
But I can’t deliver on my vision for a brighter New Mexico without you, friend. **That's why my team and I have set a goal to raise $50,000 before polls close at 7 p.m. MT tonight so we can head into the general election stronger than ever.[Please, will you chip in $5 to my campaign for Governor so I can win and deliver progress to working families across our state?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10378?t=4&akid=10076%2E400544%2EsnyxaL)**

Peter,
On April 28, SCOTUS delivered the historic Callais ruling to gut the Voting Rights Act (VRA) - the greatest rollback of civil rights in America since Jim Crow ended in the 1960s.
Within less than a month of the ruling, the far-right Louisiana state government quickly canceled elections and passed a map to eliminate one of their formerly mandated majority-Black districts. But even that wasn't enough, extremists are now pushing for a map with all majority-white districts that will remove both of LA's black Congressmen.
One lawmaker speaking on these redistricts astutely called this process out for what it is:
A political lynching.
Sadly, that wasn't even the only political lynching that Louisiana saw last month and just yesterday a State Supreme Court ruled in favor of the mob that carried it out:

In 2024, a wrongly incarcerated Black man, who fought for his own exoneration was elected to become Clerk of the Criminal Court in New Orleans. Rather than allow him to be sworn in, MAGA passed legislation to eliminate his office before he could be sworn in.
That man is Calvin Duncan. He taught himself law behind bars. Fought for his freedom and was exonerated. He then ran for Criminal Court Clerk in New Orleans to break the system that stole 28 years of his life. And he won.
Yesterday, the Louisiana Supreme Court, the same Court that is set to uphold Louisiana's new Jim Crow style map, ruled that the barbaric actions of the Louisiana state legislature to eliminate Calvin Duncan's office was constitutional.
During the time of Jim Crow Black disfranchisement went hand in hand with lynchings. How long until these political lynchings turn into real lynchings?
It starts at the highest levels with SCOTUS ruling in favor of political disenfranchisement against Black people. Then it trickles down to conservative State Supreme Courts who run cover for their extremist governors and legislatures. Finally, it trickles down to the streets where extremists take the hint and turn the state sanctioned political violence into real physical violence.
These courts are the head of the Hydra. If we hope to stop the violence before these political lynchings become real lynchings it must begin at the courts.
Defend our Courts is dedicated to cleaning house at the Supreme Court of the United States by any means necessary, including by packing the Court with liberal justices. We also fight at the state supreme court level to defend courts with Democratic majorities and capture those with conservative majorities.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: A leap of faith only works if you take it, Peter.
body:
And when you do, others will leap with you.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I learned one of the most important lessons of my life on the floor of the Texas House — more specifically, the lesson came the moment I chose to _walk off of it._
In 2021, the GOP was ramming through an extreme anti-voter bill. I felt something rising in me that I couldn’t ignore. I knew staying put meant letting Texans lose their freedom to vote.
**So I took a leap of faith.**
I stood up, texted other legislators:
“A leap of faith only works if you take it.”
Together, we ran out the clock and stopped a bill designed to silence Texas voters. That quorum break protected Sunday morning voting — a sacred tradition in Black churches — and blocked a provision that would have let partisan judges overturn election results without evidence. And we earned that victory together.
So I’ll repeat that to you today:
**A leap of faith only works if you take it.**
And when you do, others will leap with you.
**I’m taking another leap of faith with this campaign, Peter.**
Texas is on another precipice. Our schools are under attack, our freedoms are eroding, and right-wing corporate donors have more influence in the Governor’s Office than everyday Texans ever will unless we change course immediately.
If Texans take a leap of faith together next year, I know we can win this fight.
