name: Michael Baumgartner
subject: Fresh from the Trail: This week's campaign update!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vote Baumgartner for Congress | www
body:
Rodeo fun at Dayton and celebrating America in Spokane Valley.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/OwtEskrEz8a?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
|
---
| |
# Team Baumgartner joins the historic Dayton Days and Rodeo Celebration!
---
|
---
| | Last weekend, my team had a wonderful time marching in the Dayton Days Parade and sponsoring this year’s Dayton Rodeo Arena. I am proud to support an event that celebrates Western heritage, ranching traditions, and strong sense of community that make Eastern Washington so special. My team enjoyed connecting with families and community members throughout the weekend and seeing firsthand the pride people have here in Dayton and Columbia County. Events like the Dayton Days and the rodeo help keep these traditions alive, and I’m grateful for the warm welcome and support my team received from everyone. Thank you to everyone who made the weekend so special.
---
|
---
|
---
| |
# Future Famers of America celebrate the new Farm Bill!
---
| | Attending the recent 96th Washington Future Farmers of America Convention in Pullman was an unforgettable experience. I was honored to join thousands of young FFA members on the Washington State University campus, where the energy, pride, and tradition of those iconic blue jackets filled the room. I had the privilege of speaking during the closing session and the crowd erupted when I mentioned the U.S. House of Representatives passage of the Farm Bill - for the first time in almost 8 years. Click below for the video!_Farm security is food security_. I am proud to stand with our farmers, ranchers, and rural communities, and I am committed to being their strong voice in Congress. Thank you to every FFA member, advisor, and supporter who made this convention so special. Washington’s agricultural future is bright because of you!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/dzZLmpOcoHG?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
|
---
| |
# Door-Knocking in Spokane
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Our campaign is out meeting voters in our neighborhoods! Team Baumgartner has begun knocking throughout Spokane county having conversations with voters, listening to their concerns, and sharing our vision for the future. There is no substitute for meeting people where they are, and every door gives us an opportunity to build relationships and learn more about the issues that matter most to our communities. We are grateful for our volunteers and supporters who are helping us bring our message directly to voters across the district.
[Volunteer](https://us.list-manage.com/1CcsH3OsEX9?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) today to help in our efforts to connect with voters! We can share more details and let you know when we’ll be in your neighborhood.
---
| [SIGN UP!](https://us.list-manage.com/16QTYSYgKA0?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
---
|
---
| |
# Spokane Valley Picnic In The Park
---
| | My team had the pleasure to join friends and neighbors at Spokane Valley’s Picnic in the Park as the community celebrated the anniversary of signing the Declaration of Independence. Events like this remind us of the enduring principles that have guided our nation for nearly 250 years: freedom, self-government, and civic engagement. My team enjoyed patriotic music from the Navy Band, heard inspiring stories connecting local families to our nation’s founding, and reflected on the courage and vision of those who signed our founding document. It was a meaningful afternoon celebrating both our shared history and the bright future of our community and district.
---
|
---
| |
# Letter to the Editor
---
| | Thank you to our great supporter for this recent letter!
**Praise for Baumgartner (Spokesman Review)**_“Congressman Baumgartner’s latest update on his activity in the 5th Congressional District will have Democrats demanding his resignation! He met with a wide range of constituents, including business leaders, members of Eastern Washington tribes, ranchers, farmers, mayors, county commissioners, the Spokane Valley Chamber of Commerce, students, future military leaders and many others. He was engaging with as many people as possible to discuss legislation, answers questions and tried his best to learn the issues and challenges of those he represents. He tries to find workable solutions for problems and refuses to play the blame game....”_ Dave McCann, SpokaneRead more [here](https://us.list-manage.com/bK_9LjMSj2k?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238).

Please help us spread the word by writing to your local newspaper! If you would like support with a letter to the editor, please reach out to the campaign [here](mailto:stephanie@votebaumgartner.com?subject=Help%20with%20Letter%20to%20the%20Editor&body=).
---
|
---
| |
# We Need Your Help
---
| | More campaign signs will be going up over these next few weeks. _**Will you host a yard sign? **_Click [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/CiJbxUwChpp?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) to sign up now, or just send an email reply!We need volunteers! So if you have a couple of hours to spare, please reach out to us! Visit our [**website**](https://us.list-manage.com/MHoQ2EO5xHH?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)**** to sign up now!**Upcoming Events** Our campaign is in full swing as Team Baumgartner travels across Eastern Washington connecting with communities and celebrating local traditions. Check out our next events and join us!
**Saturday June 6: **[_**Reardan Mule Days.**_](https://us.list-manage.com/4e8Ii9ITd7X?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)[_****_](https://us.list-manage.com/19SCcKEnb_x?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) Our Team is looking forward to participating in Reardan Mule Days. This annual celebration started in 1904 when local resident John W. Mann organized a simple gathering of friends, neighbors, and mule breeders. It has grown over the last 120 years to a family fun festival for all to enjoy!**Saturday June 6: **[_**Rosalia Battle Days Parade. **_](https://us.list-manage.com/QZDrqY4nCIf?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)Team Baumgartner is looking forward to being back in Rosalia! This annual celebration commemorates the 1858 Battle of Pine Creek and honors the rich pioneer history of our region. **Saturday June 13:**[_**Lind Combine Demolition Derby.**_](https://us.list-manage.com/Upru57hSwf9?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) Join Team Baumgartner in attending the Lind Combine Demolition Derby in Adams County. This one of a kind event brings together our farming community in celebration of rural ingenuity, grit, and fun as massive combines battle it out in the arena._****_**Saturday June 13:**[_**Fairfield Flag Day Parade.**_****](https://us.list-manage.com/ZMa1LC4d1sb?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) Join Team Baumgartner in participating in Fairfield’s Flag Day celebration in Spokane County. This special event honors our nation’s flag and the values of patriotism, freedom, and service that unite our communities.
**Saturday June 20:**[_**Medical Lake Founders Day Parade:**_](https://us.list-manage.com/L4WoAQt8W4J?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) Join Team Baumgartner at 10 am for Medical Lake Founders Day Parade in Spokane County. Founders Day brings neighbors together each year for a parade, local festivities, and family fun. **Saturday June 20:**[_**Colville Pro Rodeo & Parade:**_](https://us.list-manage.com/8ccvvYgSN31?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)_****_ Join Team Baumgartner at 4 pm for Colville’s parade in Stevens County. This event brings together top professional rodeo athletes, thrilling competition, and classic parade fun that perfectly captures the Western spirit of our region.
[T](https://us.list-manage.com/xoJC7QoPrU3?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)hank you for all your encouragement and support!-Michael

body:

#
Hi friend, **We did it:** we crushed our April fundraising goal – and it’s all thanks to you – hard-working mid-Michiganders coming together, showing up for this movement, and stepping up when it mattered most. **I’m humbled and grateful for your support – and believe me when I say this: I don’t take _any_ of it lightly.**

Your support couldn’t have come at a better time. Right now, we’re facing a barrage of attacks from the GOP – including _$2.5 million_ worth of deceptive ads already on the way. And in a tough district like ours – especially a Trump-won district that we carried by 7 points last cycle – we can’t afford to take anything for granted.

The attacks are only going to increase as we get closer to November, but I’m staying focused on fighting for our community. Families in MI-08 are stretched thin – all thanks to the rising costs of groceries, gas, child care, and so much more.

Folks deserve someone fighting for them who doesn’t just understand these challenges – but is actually working to find real solutions that _work._ That’s what I’ve been doing in Washington, and it’s what I intend to keep doing.

## Graham Platner: the Dems' fallen star...
I've been talking a lot lately about the state of the Democrat Party:
Who they're choosing to run.
What issues they care about.
To say the least, it's interesting to watch their response to the successes of the Trump administration--talk about frantic.
Like I discussed in my last column, it seems like their answer is to run candidates whose only qualification is shock value.
Nobody sums up this phenomenon better than Graham Platner.
For lack of a better word, he's a nut.
Some of his key "qualifications"?
\- a Nazi tattoo
\- comments on women deserving sexual assault
\- profane attacks on a Purple Heart recipient
BTW (I got the chance to talk to Teddy Daniels, the Purple Heart recipient, on yesterday's show...click [HERE](https://substack.com/redirect/c5fbeb0b-3a19-4b77-8fb0-ff666667f61a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the full episode!)
If you ask me, the fact that Democrats are still serious about supporting Platner shows just how far they've fallen--and just how desperate they are for a win.
Let's get into it. ...

Peter,

Today is Primary Election Day, and as I reflect on everything we’ve accomplished together, I’m reminded of how powerful our work has been - and how much we can achieve together in Washington.

I’ve spent a huge piece of my life fighting for the people of San Francisco - taking on powerful interests and winning. Now, it’s time to take that fight to Congress to stand up to Trump’s takeover and get the government working again for the people, delivering housing, healthcare, and clean energy we can all afford.

I’ve faced attacks from right-wing extremists like Elon Musk, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Tucker Carlson, and now we’re up against big spending in this race from our borderline billionaire opponent, and outside PACs trying to push our other opponent into the lead.

Every challenge we face only deepens my resolve to show the country what courageous leadership looks like and make history for San Francisco by sending the first LGBTQ person to represent our city in Congress.

**I promise you this: I will continue to work tirelessly for the people of San Francisco, take on the fights that matter most to our community, and always listen. Your input and support mean the world to me.**

If you haven’t already, please be sure to return your ballot or vote in person by 8 PM today \- and remind your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same. My team is working around the clock to ensure every San Franciscan has their voice heard.

name: Jim Schultz
subject: Tim Walz Was An Absolutely Terrible Governor. How would Klobuchar be different?
body:
My first column for the Minnesota Star Tribune is live. Please take a look — but first, here's why I wrote it.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dd17597ae27f/the-briefing-from-mpbc-13060858?e=baf210d431)
---
| | | | |

| |

My first column for the [_**Minnesota Star Tribune**_](https://us.list-manage.com/rCq53h7xa3u?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83) is live. Please take a look — but first, here's why I wrote it. Tim Walz has been a terrible governor. Not hyperbole. Just the record. \- 2.8% job growth while the rest of America grew at 7%.\- A $19 billion surplus, gone. Replaced by a $6 billion deficit.\- 45% of kids meeting math standards. 45%.\- Murders up 63%.\- And historic fraud. Taxpayer money, looted. On his watch. Walz is almost gone. Good riddance. But here's the problem. Amy Klobuchar — who called Walz "exactly what the country needs" and voted with Biden 99% of the time — is now asking Minnesotans to hand her the keys. She's running as a moderate. So did Walz. Klobuchar is smarter than Walz — admittedly a low bar. But that doesn’t matter if she governs the same way. And right now, there is zero evidence she won't. I laid out exactly what she needs to answer for — on taxes, spending, schools, and the historic fraud. These aren't gotcha questions. They're the central questions that matter in this race. Minnesota doesn't need a more polished version of the last eight years. We can’t afford another DFL trifecta. What we need is simple, and it isn't complicated: a governor who wakes up every single morning thinking about the family stretched thin by high taxes, the kid falling behind in a classroom that stopped demanding excellence, and the small business owner who built something real and is now watching the state make it harder to survive. Minnesota has been let down by leaders who chose their party over those people. That ends when we elect someone who refuses to. Read the full column [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/W8TKgxxZXhG?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83). Send it to everyone you know who's had enough. subject: She was trafficked for 45 days before we got her home
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing.

For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.
| | | | | |
---
[ ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUULuOnTAQ_RrTGfmF4RYuolxdKcWmTEo0sQdsBWxkD6z27yNWyQekG8156Jzz821-g7SlvH6HHZ2_0lzb3CK-Q6MKy5L8bwxLqWYI8NFmJZTlwnKhbp7sgvPBatWhk-MkjJxGbbrohoeSxmuQsFhpzWgE2Ie2i7c2jI8wdsndTsIKJa0ZtOqnX4Px06AnWNAjPpgR5xGAsPW-5Ib1AkoXppzLfZXc-7J3m4tER2P6C1Mvpl6hZCDsKWLEWrAtpcZzh5zooy91ZeqVP8WwcaqQcsor95gJK9_gzD7yFkul-eBHOZh-VfRnrSmvTD-pnsiUPWmfyTP9_Prjm-L_WvwFfMmEmZh-4g5pk1114XhP25aaHZkR6_39TE7_v_Xl1J8AAAD__9tgj3I)
---
Friend,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUULuOnTAQ_RrTGfmF4RYuolxdKcWmTEo0sQdsBWxkD6z27yNWyQekG8156Jzz821-g7SlvH6HHZ2_0lzb3CK-Q6MKy5L8bwxLqWYI8NFmJZTlwnKhbp7sgvPBatWhk-MkjJxGbbrohoeSxmuQsFhpzWgE2Ie2i7c2jI8wdsndTsIKJa0ZtOqnX4Px06AnWNAjPpgR5xGAsPW-5Ib1AkoXppzLfZXc-7J3m4tER2P6C1Mvpl6hZCDsKWLEWrAtpcZzh5zooy91ZeqVP8WwcaqQcsor95gJK9_gzD7yFkul-eBHOZh-VfRnrSmvTD-pnsiUPWmfyTP9_Prjm-L_WvwFfMmEmZh-4g5pk1114XhP25aaHZkR6_39TE7_v_Xl1J8AAAD__9tgj3I)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUULuOnTAQ_RrTGfmF4RYuolxdKcWmTEo0sQdsBWxkD6z27yNWyQekG8156Jzz821-g7SlvH6HHZ2_0lzb3CK-Q6MKy5L8bwxLqWYI8NFmJZTlwnKhbp7sgvPBatWhk-MkjJxGbbrohoeSxmuQsFhpzWgE2Ie2i7c2jI8wdsndTsIKJa0ZtOqnX4Px06AnWNAjPpgR5xGAsPW-5Ib1AkoXppzLfZXc-7J3m4tER2P6C1Mvpl6hZCDsKWLEWrAtpcZzh5zooy91ZeqVP8WwcaqQcsor95gJK9_gzD7yFkul-eBHOZh-VfRnrSmvTD-pnsiUPWmfyTP9_Prjm-L_WvwFfMmEmZh-4g5pk1114XhP25aaHZkR6_39TE7_v_Xl1J8AAAD__9tgj3I)

| [MAKE A GIFT TODAY](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUULuOnTAQ_RrTGfmF4RYuolxdKcWmTEo0sQdsBWxkD6z27yNWyQekG8156Jzz821-g7SlvH6HHZ2_0lzb3CK-Q6MKy5L8bwxLqWYI8NFmJZTlwnKhbp7sgvPBatWhk-MkjJxGbbrohoeSxmuQsFhpzWgE2Ie2i7c2jI8wdsndTsIKJa0ZtOqnX4Px06AnWNAjPpgR5xGAsPW-5Ib1AkoXppzLfZXc-7J3m4tER2P6C1Mvpl6hZCDsKWLEWrAtpcZzh5zooy91ZeqVP8WwcaqQcsor95gJK9_gzD7yFkul-eBHOZh-VfRnrSmvTD-pnsiUPWmfyTP9_Prjm-L_WvwFfMmEmZh-4g5pk1114XhP25aaHZkR6_39TE7_v_Xl1J8AAAD__9tgj3I "MAKE A GIFT TODAY")

**Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.

name: Ben Blom
subject: Our ambitious work is healing redwood forests
body:
Dear Peter,

Nearly 100 years ago, California’s redwood forests were almost lost forever.

Many forests still bear scars of the past from those decades of industrial logging: crumbling logging roads, streams buried and choked with debris, and spindly, damaged young trees left competing for space and straining for light.

Restoring these forests is a monumental task, but it is possible. We’re already making great progress, together, through Redwoods Rising.

Now in its eighth year, Redwoods Rising is well on its way to achieving the ambitious goal of healing and restoring 70,000 acres of damaged forests within Redwood National and State Parks— but we need your help to keep up this tremendous momentum. [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising]

HELP REDWOODS SOAR ONCE MORE [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising]

Forest restoration work is painstaking and careful. Many logged redwood forests were originally replanted with dense stands of other species, resulting in crowded forest floors that can fuel fires and impede native plant growth.

Our work removes individual trees from dense stands to strategically thin the forest, allowing for healthy growth and maturity.This is possible with machinery like harvesters, cable yarders, and hand fallers that minimize impact on the forest floor.

Many of the equipment operators come from local communities. With Redwoods Rising, we’ve created a restoration economy, one that injects dollars into local communities and provides well-paying jobs.

Some of these workers once learned their skills working for lumber companies. Now, they’re working to heal those same forests.

JOIN REDWOODS RISING [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising]

And there is plenty more hands-on restoration work to go around. Our teams and field technicians roll up their sleeves, sometimes even wading into waterways to carefully move native species like fish and amphibians to safety, one by one.

As we remove old logging roads and unearth streams that were once buried, these species will find more resilient homes in fully restored habitats.

GIVE DAMAGED FORESTS A SECOND CHANCE [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/redwoodsrising]

With your help we have already:
* Restored 5,000+ acres of redwood forests
* Removed and reforested more than 39 miles of old, failing logging roads
* Supported 200+ local jobs and raised more than $146 million for local restoration
* Repaired or replaced 35 bridges and stream culverts to preserve native habitats

Every season of Redwoods Rising progress makes the next year possible. Across the range we are now preparing for a busy summer restoration season, one that will set the stage for the next summer, and the summer after that...

Each step forward is another step toward a future where these damaged forests will soar once more to their historic heights . I want to witness that future for myself—and I know you do too.
Thank you for being part of this incredible work and helping the redwoods rise.

Sincerely,
Ben Blom
Director of Stewardship and Restoration

Photos by Max Forster

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

clean_body: A quick look at what’s happening right now | | | | | Peter, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." name: Erika Kirk
subject: I hold onto every word he left for me
body:
Charlie never missed writing a single one | | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
What I wouldn't give for one more love letter from Charlie.

One more handwritten note left beside my coffee before he rushed out the door.

One more folded piece of paper on my pillow before he had an early flight.

One more moment where he intentionally set aside the noise of the world just to remind me that I was loved.

About this time last year, Charlie and I sat together on-stage at the Women's Leadership Summit (WLS), answering questions from young women about marriage, family, faith, raising children, and the kind of future they hoped to have one day.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=4dcbddf55b574de1817469c6910ceb5c&_e=UJHOF7_9HniE5R07CWMfdCRKHILzzJHieKWRqimbEOfUb09spUQWWwYexoS9vXMbP5-3wAultczgM13g0WlJ0rzCUoUKf0HykeGMRrVcMUe0-I1MrcgowQzPY0Hr1Sr7RUq1V40KVbwxAECgxrVt2AawkBo92i7pRcVnHNY11B2cWjNVgy6eaVYHG9d6JmqmQfMBrPj1-fgjIq4GYfqjxDjQIlVnFb9KRANjsvXejlICrCWbmvLkaSJRuSB1k21q6nh_oIH5RGIPPjcnE10O5J3Dw3gYTSo8zqoVvrDmn39eLu3ByapUvZu5s_nONWPs1uCzc--BxM6e4mmmO3F1amKiuM5xV2jbI1TCZuK3W3dlk89UVNHwxTUeAp9SVU2ZpBG84zldwNZlDThs31w_82260-Q1fQBaO-aZbT8lcDtHYhbxOJCa78OyaN4PPHgvNyhdJHxSsewSe4aoxPkjW6R4f7QPs_NuQm2g-jCrn-jNosyqzs3k-KaeaIY7-4EnVcfRd0Shf1xk_YGYr3xeTP0NSHXQOTud4eKFWaGzdboddLJCD2GCqGWJjcwceWG6U6Hm2rKh32EXT5_xxZDd3DwdMmzk-6ES_vEudEFwDnv-iHES-dQXSkaGvML6xxCxClZMkieDHzULmYSvFiArEkuMNapAhNUvnRk33tkgHgp4gcsYNON50d6BJsGhsRJwIyJTUlO9ESt4pSZ8hPJpdJNP33s48ZcwFyB7F4daGLbWiDqERbcYdXSmH09ENbmB)
---
Somewhere during that conversation, I mentioned the notes he would write to me.

They were one of the many quiet ways Charlie loved me.

I shared that he would write them whenever he had a moment while he honored the Sabbath.

_He never missed one. _

Sometimes they were only a few sentences, but they carried such a deep reverence about them. He'd hand me words that felt sacred.

I saved every single one of those letters.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=4dcbddf55b574de1817469c6910ceb5c&_e=UJHOF7_9HniE5R07CWMfdCRKHILzzJHieKWRqimbEOfUb09spUQWWwYexoS9vXMbP5-3wAultczgM13g0WlJ0rzCUoUKf0HykeGMRrVcMUe0-I1MrcgowQzPY0Hr1Sr7RUq1V40KVbwxAECgxrVt2AawkBo92i7pRcVnHNY11B2cWjNVgy6eaVYHG9d6JmqmQfMBrPj1-fgjIq4GYfqjxDjQIlVnFb9KRANjsvXejlICrCWbmvLkaSJRuSB1k21q6nh_oIH5RGIPPjcnE10O5M_3aAdXlAo-obwJ0u6-h62zJucfwTpXzeqk6-bZwCzt06bfSmXTnsoeVhTWonfFPv8D6Y2ukRWoBKPdoWSgoYqTRjqWzw0HP2jiI_Ajfa45aAD0qOe7OKrM3ZYGVuF1d-r-JJHxMd-eVR3QUkZlmTbFyzANVw1N8zjlzrTP0qXGvTCYemue-76acRGxH8EmknF4Jnhavwt-wfy8egx-ArjWsZ9qsLvpKWwJFwcEXzzIBX-Aw0UHe2gSs9F4sWUNOWGrIrWw74YDUk28LMfmp_gWXR1pAAsdCa3juFacmZOTokVGT5ORirgsJjLttztGtBPnPs6Sth3XYMdJz7IgBvU12GrK5hjjWrTFNjbuXs9IkEzpBGAdZUqnNs1t7RELzeZ8UTiDhO98UBxsPs4ZZygGNOf_0PEftPgCK9WJEyDI8j8sJgo4NplWDboUz_EqKEUxPsep-8-Rv2nK2xckbdvtuXzFJDFARxWcLkcr1R5j)
---
Charlie knew how much those little notes meant to me, and now I treasure them in a way I never could have understood at the time.

I hold onto every word he left for me.

And looking back, I think about the young women in the room listening to us that night at the Women's Leadership Summit.

Because so many of those young women were longing for something this culture keeps trying to convince them no longer matters.

A strong family. A faithful marriage. Children raised in a home filled with purpose and love.

A life rooted in God instead of endless striving and the empty pursuit of self.

And honestly, Friend, I think that ache runs much deeper than most people realize.

I see it constantly when I meet young women across the country.

So many feel exhausted by the pressure to chase an image of success that leaves them anxious, disconnected, and lonely.

They've been told that fulfillment comes from constant achievement... endless comparison... putting themselves first.

But as I said last year, the enemy has a way of disguising bondage as empowerment.

I think that's part of why so many young women are drawn to the Women's Leadership Summit in the first place.

Because for one weekend, thousands of young women come together and realize they are not alone for wanting a different kind of life.

They meet other young women who still love God, still believe family matters, and still want meaningful lives rooted in faith and purpose.
---
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=4dcbddf55b574de1817469c6910ceb5c&_e=UJHOF7_9HniE5R07CWMfdCRKHILzzJHieKWRqimbEOfUb09spUQWWwYexoS9vXMbP5-3wAultczgM13g0WlJ0rzCUoUKf0HykeGMRrVcMUe0-I1MrcgowQzPY0Hr1Sr7RUq1V40KVbwxAECgxrVt2AawkBo92i7pRcVnHNY11B2cWjNVgy6eaVYHG9d6JmqmQfMBrPj1-fgjIq4GYfqjxDjQIlVnFb9KRANjsvXejlICrCWbmvLkaSJRuSB1k21q6nh_oIH5RGIPPjcnE10O5GWTlciA3_9TN4TEYPPFdL_bXZjSM9IrTEE988qM-siRUx0n0i_jEI3BwEh4xLzGLv3SgV8rRo-deYduvApdtEqYCF4xhUXtSWsv_M1NSBf1Vl_hNCWTr25sy4wRrohdAna4HUMzlD_pRW4wlmpK8dTzKGxVVJalyr-gBzPMdo0T3M2eH2a1N1fWVuYCI5nTzlfJyNqmr8j_pljJaT0PReMvRsYdcGiIPjsvirhRTEop4mGd3iRbfu81ffeBIzETSxxMJY5nh9AtbPipTyG5swoB5BdnUQ3OShTUp99AE_3o65tYdgpC16rDS__IBneeeX1oXAFzBej_DxwwxjJN_C2zWhtFkGfa4kYqj-lMXWH5ny8EWK1SwXe_MG55WsyEYpA14VsTjbFsHMSzXieLk0nJGdlcQi-Jb4fM9Hf5BB2VVDIDcEINbhZENqbCH6BszaUsP4hppyYRQvmDRk8j249q8BUYP3AuMx17bfNeVQ69)
---
Last year during our question-and-answer session at the Women's Leadership Summit, one young woman walked up to the microphone... and Charlie recognized her immediately.

Before she could even ask her question, Charlie's face lit up with a huge smile as he said, _" Hey! So... you're getting married!" _

The room burst into cheers as she smiled and nodded her head.

And then Charlie reminded everyone why he recognized her in the first place.

The year before, she had stood at the mic and asked him a simple question:

_" How do I meet a husband?" _

A year later, she came back to WLS engaged.

I smile thinking about how excited everyone in that room was for her.

I see moments like that every year at the Women's Leadership Summit. And after I leave, I always carry home a deep sense of hope about this next generation of young women.

Not because they have everything figured out.

That's why this event matters so deeply to me.

Before I met Charlie, I was not dreaming about marriage, motherhood, and building a family.

But when I met the right man, everything shifted. Everything changed.

And before doors open in San Antonio for the Women's Leadership Summit this June, I just want to thank you for helping make this event possible year after year.

Thank you for helping us continue pouring into these young women.

Thank you for helping carry forward a mission that changes so many lives -- including mine.

**P.S.** Looking back now, I think some of the moments that leave the deepest mark on your life are the ones you almost don't realize are sacred while you're living them.

A love note on Saturday. A prayer before bed. A husband asking how he can better serve you.

You don't realize until much later that those small acts of love and faithfulness were quietly building something eternal inside your home.

I read all of Charlie's love letters even slower now.

And as I read his words, the weight on my heart reminds me that we were never promised gray hair and rocking chairs -- even though we assumed it was guaranteed.

Charlie and I built our marriage around the kind of covenant described in Ephesians 5 -- rooted in faith, sacrifice, service, and putting Christ at the center of our home.

And it's another reason why Charlie cared so deeply about our nation's young people -- both men and women.

Get married.
Have children.
Build a legacy.
Pass down your values.
Pursue the eternal.
Seek true joy.

That kind of life may not be what this culture celebrates anymore... but I still believe with my whole heart that it is the life so many young women are quietly searching for.

** Summer Movie Fundraiser to Support Autism Health
------------------------------------------------------------

Summer Movie Fundraiser Supporting Autism Health Inc.

Looking for a fun and easy way to support Autism Health this summer? Through our partnership with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas, you can purchase a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle while helping advance our mission of supporting individuals and families impacted by autism.

For just $30 per order, you'll receive a bundle that includes two Standard 2D Movie Tickets, redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, 20% of every purchase will be donated directly to Autism Health to help fund our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives.

Whether you're planning a family movie night, a date night, or looking for a thoughtful gift, this is a great opportunity to enjoy a movie while giving back to a meaningful cause.

Campaign Ends: Monday, August 17, 2026

Thank you for helping us continue our mission of serving the autism community. Every ticket purchased makes a difference. Click on the link below to purchase your tickets.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://www.groupraise.com/offer-campaigns/78957-autism-health-inc-regal-fundraising-campaigns?mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID)

AHS Recordings Now Available Online

Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online.

This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace.

We are offering two recording options:
• General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members
• Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits

Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit.
BUY HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA.

Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=a23a5433-a8ec-4114-9d95-978462f7661b&mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year

We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards.

Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children.

The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as:
“An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.”

We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference.

Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com (https://track.pstmrk.it/3/www.warriormom.com%2F/b43o/wnbFAQ/AQ/6c680ed6-2635-49e7-8aaa-ca5f583946a9/4/mxPAv6kITa?mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID)

VOTE HERE (https://apply.internationalimpactbookawards.com/public-voting-form?mc_cid=298a9d6890&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.

clean_body: Summer Movie Fundraiser to Support Autism Health Summer Movie Fundraiser Supporting Autism Health Inc. Looking for a fun and easy way to support Autism Health this summer? Through our partnership with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas, you can purchase a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle while helping advance our mission of supporting individuals and families impacted by autism. For just $30 per order, you'll receive a bundle that includes two Standard 2D Movie Tickets, redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, 20% of every purchase will be donated directly to Autism Health to help fund our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives. Whether you're planning a family movie night, a date night, or looking for a thoughtful gift, this is a great opportunity to enjoy a movie while giving back to a meaningful cause. Campaign Ends: Monday, August 17, 2026 Thank you for helping us continue our mission of serving the autism community. Every ticket purchased makes a difference. Click on the link below to purchase your tickets. BUY TICKETS HERE () AHS Recordings Now Available Online Missed the Autism Health Summit or want to revisit your favorite presentations? We are excited to announce that the full 3-day recordings from the Autism Health Summit are now available for purchase online. This year’s Summit featured an extraordinary lineup of physicians, researchers, advocates, and thought leaders discussing emerging science, integrative approaches, environmental factors, clinical insights, and practical strategies for individuals impacted by autism and neurological conditions. Now, you can access these powerful presentations from the comfort of your home and learn at your own pace. We are offering two recording options: • General Recordings for parents, caregivers, and community members • Professional Track Recordings for medical professionals seeking to earn 10.5 CME credits Whether you attended the conference in person or could not join us in San Diego, this is an incredible opportunity to gain access to valuable education and expert insight from the Autism Health Summit. BUY HERE () Save the Date: Cocktails for A Cause We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health Inc. on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA. Sponsored by Cellular Performance Institute, this special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, inspiring presentations from featured speakers (to be announced), and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences. Tickets are $85 per person, and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health Inc.’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions. We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families. BUY TICKETS HERE () Please Vote for the 2026 Author of the Year We are honored to share that Tracy Slepcevic, Co-Founder and President of Autism Health Inc., has been nominated for the 2026 Author of the Year award through the International Impact Book Awards. Tracy’s bestselling book, Warrior Mom: A Mother's Journey in Healing Her Son with Autism, has inspired and empowered families around the world through her heartfelt story of perseverance, faith, and determination as a mother navigating the autism journey. More than just a memoir, Warrior Mom has become a trusted guidebook for parents seeking hope, practical insight, and encouragement while advocating for their children. The book has received praise from many respected voices, including the endorsement from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who described Warrior Mom as: “An inspiring testimony to the miraculous power of maternal love.” We would deeply appreciate your support in helping recognize Tracy’s impact and dedication to the autism community. Voting closes on August 31, 2026, and every vote makes a difference. Learn more about Warrior Mom at: www.WarriorMom.com () VOTE HERE () About Autism Health Inc. Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders. And so did our community. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAena4mY8LZbHedz9lZM4amKOf6-_dcwDOMcnkTqeaZQ51R7SMXzRJum6WHMPBnRKB5kQ-wTf-1UiQA_Kcgi4RjueB2DdiTZWrlQdg3BTYZSXLd30J4J-JajwI-KdxCZrz3SVlLceZCzq_7AHMTtCyOxr-1FzdYs9_SQrxTv8D3_YJHxIfPTaJJb2pJJUrgxbiRDfPlUHSnZLHoNxMTyrBmUNkAcgZ6Q61Gu-RCwb2mCTA8a_dQ6s3MATzXEa38I3DtzqVHKMiiWN1-RevMlwvPS85iXTgCujg9zvOp8cI7x4lnLKfN5TB4rBCWcVYnQ20Lxkpp41cbOSvyFqWeI1tTRUVGWUlwTFA4AeF85iyiYeKNdD2EsEvwA4jYOkEtf-Gt5DcOQINAp-HhVAlc9Ch5PS05fgpGlR8_rG3QlqPvm1E/4r5/4ppIgAHDQo6LclId3HYEdA/h1/h001.k5UW895LeaMrDkuW73a30pMUSaXRCYWN2O8-ZYwHvgc) Serena, one of our members who joined us door-knocking, said it best: _"Community is very important for building a better future because it gives people like me the courage to build solutions that will benefit us now and future generations."_ For Serena, that courage grew through every connection made — learning names, building trust, and inviting neighbors to be part of something bigger. clean_body: When we build spaces rooted in culture and belonging, people don’t just show up — they stay, they organize, and they lead. | | | Peter, something extraordinary happened in Los Angeles, and I want you to hear about it. United We Dream hosted a multi-day cultural activation rooted in community, immigrant pride, and the belief that we, the people, have the power to build the future we deserve. From community outreach trainings to door-knocking at USC and Los Angeles City College, to a joyful Coffee & Cultura DJ Set & Day Party at With Love Cafe in South LA — our members showed up. And so did our community. Serena, one of our members who joined us door-knocking, said it best: "Community is very important for building a better future because it gives people like me the courage to build solutions that will benefit us now and future generations." For Serena, that courage grew through every connection made — learning names, building trust, and inviting neighbors to be part of something bigger. That is the power of relational organizing in action. And it works. Together, we achieved so much: ✊🏽 We welcomed Homies Unidos as a new affiliate — a grassroots powerhouse dedicated to healing, violence prevention, and immigrant empowerment across LA and Central America. 🫱🏼🫲🏾 We laid the foundation for a new community chapter in Orange County and a student-led chapter at Los Angeles City College. 🎨 We forged new bonds with local artists, creatives, and vendors who share our vision for justice. This event proved what we’ve always believed: when we build spaces rooted in culture and belonging, people don’t just show up — they stay, they organize, and they lead. Joy and culture are the front doors to political power. By leading with connection, we turn moments into movements. President Donald Trump signed an executive order Tuesday asking companies to **[provide artificial intelligence models to the federal government](https://substack.com/redirect/be78bb55-85fd-44e5-8b66-66a81e599973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to assess their capabilities ahead of a full release.

---|---|---
* **Government Early Access:** Companies are asked to give the federal government early access to AI models for capability assessment before full release.
* **Private Signing Held:** The executive order was signed privately in the Oval Office weeks after postponing a public event.
* **Innovation Security Focus:** The order promotes advanced artificial intelligence innovation and security per its official title.

# Alphabet raises $80B for AI buildout
Alphabet announced plans Monday to sell $80 billion in stock, including a $10 billion investment from Berkshire Hathaway, **[to fund AI compute infrastructure](https://substack.com/redirect/b1e8ba1d-3fae-42fd-aeab-b0b9fc685b6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid surging customer demand for its solutions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1e8ba1d-3fae-42fd-aeab-b0b9fc685b6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Stock Sale Funds AI:** The capital will support investments in world-class AI compute to meet unprecedented customer demand for solutions and services.
* **Capex Forecast Updated:** Alphabet raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to as much as $190 billion to support AI growth.
* **Berkshire Investment:** Berkshire Hathaway will contribute $10 billion as part of broader $30 billion underwritten offerings and $40 billion at-the-market program.
* **AI Demand Surges:** Strong enterprise and consumer demand for AI is exceeding supply, prompting scaled investments in foundational infrastructure.

* * *
* * *
# Anthropic Expands Mythos AI to 150 Partners
Anthropic announced it is **[granting access to its powerful Mythos AI model](https://substack.com/redirect/63a7600f-a263-4dac-b710-5f7de772b459?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to an additional 150 partners in more than 15 countries through Project Glasswing, including new industries such as power, water and healthcare.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/63a7600f-a263-4dac-b710-5f7de772b459?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Project Glasswing Grows:** The expansion includes industries not well-represented initially such as power, water, healthcare, communications and hardware.
* **Vulnerabilities Uncovered:** Partners have revealed more than 10,000 high or critical security flaws since the initial launch.
* **Security Requirements Strict:** New partners must meet rigorous security standards before accessing the vulnerability-finding AI model.
* **IPO Timing Strategic:** The expansion coincides with Anthropic's confidential IPO prospectus filing and offering Mythos to the European Union.

* * *
* * *
# Companies suffer sticker shock at soaring AI bills post-binge
Companies **[are rethinking their heavy AI adoption as prices rise sharply,](https://substack.com/redirect/200f44aa-63d1-4229-ab41-b2d0a672d0da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** particularly for advanced AI agents that consume far more tokens than simple chatbots, ending the era of subsidized intelligence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/200f44aa-63d1-4229-ab41-b2d0a672d0da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Token Costs Exploding:** Agent-powered tasks can burn dozens of times more tokens, driving exponential cost increases especially in development and coding uses.
* **Usage Binge Backlash:** Some firms saw token costs exceed employee salaries within months due to overzealous "tokenmaxxing" practices.
* **Meta Reins In Use:** Meta's CTO advised employees against using AI tools just for the sake of it amid productivity questions from leaders like Uber.
* **Shift to Open Source:** Businesses are turning to free open-source models as more affordable alternatives to premium options from OpenAI and Anthropic.

# HPE stock skyrockets 30% on earnings beat
Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares **[skyrocketed 30 percent Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/6b7c4099-a21d-4562-a4e5-b1b15d874f95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after reporting blockbuster second-quarter results that blew away estimates with revenue up 40 percent and its biggest earnings beat since 2018.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b7c4099-a21d-4562-a4e5-b1b15d874f95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Server Revenue Strong:** Server revenue came in at $5.45 billion, nearly $1 billion ahead of estimates within the cloud and AI unit.
* **EPS Guidance Raised:** The company bumped its full-year EPS guidance by a full dollar, projecting fiscal 2026 EPS of $3.35 to $3.45.
* **AI Infrastructure Demand:** Customers continue to invest in modernizing infrastructure and scaling AI with triple-digit growth in traditional server bookings.
* **Security Focus Accelerates:** Industries focused on security are seeing rapid acceleration for AI on-premises instead of in the cloud.

# Florida AG sues OpenAI and Sam Altman personally
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier **[filed an 83-page lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman](https://substack.com/redirect/ed265f1a-af21-46c9-be9d-b7240eba6a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , alleging ChatGPT aided mass shooters, drove suicides and harmed users while the company pursued the AI arms race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ed265f1a-af21-46c9-be9d-b7240eba6a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Personal Liability Sought:** The complaint seeks to hold Altman personally liable for alleged harm due to his utter disregard for risk to human life as CEO.
* **ChatGPT Harms Listed:** The suit claims the chatbot helped deadly rampages, caused addiction in minors and feigned human compassion while harming critical thinking skills.
* **Deceptive Practices Claimed:** OpenAI is accused of violating the Florida Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act by knowingly releasing an unsafe product.
* **First State Action:** Florida is the first state to sue OpenAI and expects others will follow, with a separate criminal investigation continuing.

# SpaceX reserves 5% IPO shares for employees
SpaceX has[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/06b84a61-3fb8-4acf-a968-f4eb182b28ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[reserved up to 5 percent of stock in its upcoming IPO](https://substack.com/redirect/06b84a61-3fb8-4acf-a968-f4eb182b28ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for purchase by certain employees and persons through a direct share program managed by Morgan Stanley.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/06b84a61-3fb8-4acf-a968-f4eb182b28ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **IPO Raise Expected:** The offering is expected to bring in a record sum in the range of $75 billion after valuation at $1.25 trillion.
* **Selection Discretionary:** Participants will be selected based on the discretion of executive officers with no lock-up restrictions on the stock.
* **Direct Share Program:** The provision allows certain individuals to reap benefits mostly accrued by large money managers with underwriter relationships.
* **Anthropic Compute Deal:** SpaceX is leasing compute capacity equivalent to approximately 325,000 NVIDIA GPUs to Anthropic with potential early termination.

# Blue Origin launchpad delay to 2028 possible after explosion
NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said Blue Origin's launchpad[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ead5973a-34cd-4762-b041-a7bb6ade2f76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[damaged by the recent New Glenn rocket explosion](https://substack.com/redirect/ead5973a-34cd-4762-b041-a7bb6ade2f76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** may not be restored until 2028, impacting Artemis contracts and satellite missions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1c6b93c5-c696-42e6-8473-310b8bb92861?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Explosion Incident:** The uncrewed New Glenn rocket erupted into a fireball during a hot-fire test on Thursday at Cape Canaveral.
* **Recovery Timeline:** Isaacman noted recovering the pad will take serious time based on historical launch pad rebuild data.
* **Artemis Program Impact:** NASA has contracts with Blue Origin for an uncrewed Blue Moon lander atop New Glenn later this year.
* **Customer Missions Affected:** Amazon's 48-satellite launch and AST SpaceMobile's direct-to-device system rely on Blue Origin rockets.

# Bitcoin drops below $70K, lowest since April
Bitcoin dropped more than 4 percent Tuesday **[to hover below $70,000,](https://substack.com/redirect/742abdbc-12fc-4cef-94dc-f9bf17dd41d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** its lowest level since April 8, amid souring sentiment after major holder Strategy sold tokens for the first time since 2022.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/742abdbc-12fc-4cef-94dc-f9bf17dd41d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strategy Sale Trigger:** Strategy offloaded around $2.5 million of its massive $59 billion bitcoin position, signaling a shift from aggressive buy-and-hold.
* **ETF Outflows Continue:** Spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen outflows for an unprecedented 11 consecutive days nearing $3.5 billion.
* **Crypto Sentiment Low:** Bitcoin is falling even as the US stock market hits new highs driven by AI exuberance.
* **Other Cryptos Decline:** Ether and Solana also fell on Tuesday though not as sharply as Bitcoin.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_**by David Shuster**_
One of the marvels of the United States under Trump is the ability of the ruling billionaire class to transform inconvenience into virtue. Gasoline prices rise, and workers are expected to endure it. Commutes become more expensive, and workers are expected to just pay more.
Never mind that countless workers are driving hours each day to a job that largely involves communicating with colleagues by email and video conference.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And yet any suggestion that this arrangement is absurd is treated, at least by many company owners, as a subversive threat.
The actual threat can be seen with basic math. Thanks to Trump's war against Iran, the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked, global oil reserves are dwindling, and gasoline prices keep going higher.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Before the war, the average U.S. price for regular unleaded was about $3.00/gallon. Now, it is $4.50/gallon and rising.
The most patriotic thing many employers could do today is permit and encourage remote work wherever it is practical. Not next year. Not after another H.R. study. Not after six months of strategic planning and PowerPoint presentations. Now.
Every worker who stays home is one less commuter burning gasoline. Every empty stretch of highway is a small reduction in demand. Every avoided commute leaves more money in the pocket of a family already being squeezed by rising prices. If the nation is confronting an energy shock, then reducing unnecessary fuel consumption is not merely good economics. It is common sense.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.BY9xNuvn3SS7j_DNlaLnW8MUeGJ3HaN8H9vte7EWVAc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=200183731)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet common sense has never been the strong suit of America's managerial aristocracy.
For decades, executives insisted that productivity required fluorescent lighting, open floor plans, and the daily migration of workers into office towers resembling climate-controlled ant colonies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then came the Covid pandemic, and millions of Americans worked from home. The prophets of doom, particularly conservatives, predicted catastrophe. They insisted productivity would collapse, innovation would vanish, and civilization itself might crumble.
Instead, a curious thing happened.
Many workers performed just as well as before. Many performed better.
Study after study found what employees had long suspected: remove the commute, reduce the interruptions, eliminate the endless parade of unnecessary conference room meetings, and people often accomplish more. Freed from the rituals and theater of office life, workers got down to the business of working.
This should have settled the matter.
Instead, after the pandemic ended, many corporations launched a crusade to drag employees back to their desks.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=200183731&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwMTgzNzMxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODA0MjU4NzgsImV4cCI6MTc4MzAxNzg3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.sMSi-vcRcuXAXlfn_PD895ehTOpnq_jjr6y0_g1yts4)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The stated reasons often sounded noble: Collaboration. Culture. Team spirit. The actual reasons were less inspiring. Empty office buildings are expensive. Commercial real estate investors dislike vacancies. Managers who measure their worth by the number of subordinates visible from their office windows need audiences.
The worker, meanwhile, is expected to absorb the cost.
This expectation reflects a broad and troubling reality. In recent years, particularly during the Trump era, many corporations and billionaires have exhibited almost no regard for the welfare of ordinary working people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Labor protections are often treated as inconveniences. Unions are portrayed as nuisances. Employee demands for flexibility, security, and dignity are greeted as though they were extravagant requests for private yachts.
Yet the same corporations, when their own interests are at stake, never hesitate to seek public subsidies, tax advantages, regulatory favors, or government assistance.
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=200183731&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwMTgzNzMxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODA0MjU4NzgsImV4cCI6MTc4MzAxNzg3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.sMSi-vcRcuXAXlfn_PD895ehTOpnq_jjr6y0_g1yts4&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The imbalance has become impossible to ignore.
The American economy does not run because hedge fund managers attend conferences in Aspen. It does not function because billionaire investors acquire their fifth mansion. The U.S. economy runs because millions of ordinary people answer phones, write on computers, process accounts, analyze data, guide consumers, serve customers, and perform the countless tasks that keep modern society operating.
Those workers deserve better than lectures about sacrifice from executives arriving at corporate headquarters in chauffeured sedans.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If patriotism means anything beyond bumper stickers and campaign slogans, it must include a willingness to improve the lives of fellow citizens. A company that allows remote work where feasible reduces fuel consumption, lowers household expenses, eases traffic congestion, and grants workers greater control over their lives. It strengthens families. It improves morale. It also almost always improves productivity.
That is not radicalism. It is simply good stewardship.
America faces enough genuine problems without manufacturing additional ones by forcing millions of people into unnecessary commutes.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.BY9xNuvn3SS7j_DNlaLnW8MUeGJ3HaN8H9vte7EWVAc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=200183731)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ea9032c-feca-4699-97d5-184b9eaa0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The closure of a distant waterway may be beyond our control. The daily decisions of employers are not.
If corporate leaders truly wish to demonstrate their devotion to country, they can begin with a remarkably simple act: trust their employees, respect their time, and let them work from home.
America will survive the experience. The economy may even improve.

| | June is Pride Month — a time to honor the courage of LGBTQ+ Americans who've fought for equal rights and a more perfect union for all. It's also a time to recommit to the work we still need to get done to ensure every one of our LGBTQ+ neighbors has the freedom and opportunity to live as their authentic self. **In the Senate this Congress, I've teamed up with my colleagues, Senator Tammy Baldwin and Senator Cory Booker, to reintroduce the Equality Act. The Equality Act is bold, historic legislation to make comprehensive civil rights protections for LGBTQ+ Americans the law of the land. Equality should never depend on your zip code.** Despite the progress we've made, it's painfully clear: equal justice is still not a reality for everyone in America. The Trump Administration, MAGA Republicans, and right-wing state legislatures are escalating coordinated attacks on the rights, security, and freedoms of LGBTQ+ Americans nationwide. **The Equality Act is about freedom.** The freedom for everyone to fully participate in every aspect of life and live as their authentic self without fear. Generations of Americans have marched, voted, organized, and raised their voices to fight for a vision of America as a free and equal nation for all. **By leading the Equality Act, we're fighting to expand freedom and open the doors of opportunity for everyone.** Back in 2007, as the Speaker of the Oregon House, I successfully led the fight to secure equality for Oregonians, and it is way past time for Congress to do the same for all LGBTQ+ Americans by passing the Equality Act. These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

clean_body: This might be a sign of something bigger | | | | | Peter, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Peter, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Reuters: US Postal Service seeks to require states to submit lists of voters [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Reuters_USPSBallotList.png]
Keeping this one short because it's urgent, Folks.
One day after a federal judge declined to immediately block President Donald Trump's executive order suppressing mail-in voting, the U.S. Postal Service proposed new rules would require states to provide lists of voters utilizing mail-in voting and not deliver ballots to anyone not listed.
This impacts voters two ways: First, it requires states to submit voter data to the federal government despite the Constitution saying states control voting. Second, it would empower the USPS to withhold delivery of a ballot you requested from your state.
Simply put -- we have no idea what Trump and his team are going to do with the data they receive from states, and they've made no promises to honor the integrity of those lists and not try and remove people they don't think should vote by mail.
