| | Patriot,
---
I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=38c9bc916f974b0b8d649374a740eb3a&_e=Uvw4YEF3Xyf4wbdk4zbiJ_5iXikFqx71ulcyhdHFXZ4Ma0Sc72kmK1-Ocdjt3bQZtbHyDaTAbSnHxBnUrfyqk33fITixhcJ4fFlGz062VHErORWC5bvgrAdPXTbapEwNSVtbwHzh0XDgSsOl6z0o8pYYtqWEG5tjJw35X3Qc8YyD7REUGBMwebOorH0tbOngyRI8HeSQYGsOV0kpUWsbzw5BdkQEgjXtn-oSk-c2EOI0omSee2JlQnXa-1YHru9KjMlNo53m0OXTVyVzzATkAO47_eDiFxmJQ3LqSbCJG8gRbnZAh4CERvYH8VQZ7PstVU8KpLwTQBTAZzf5F95ZQ-BxwRWhcLB8XHoeYuQyMCmqYqnluGYxubSJ339Q-C6xHxNqPq_R-SC1Z2y3RZckyOqPAvGwypP_B2Oo7bqS8JSPltgQGyHlrJTFkNHML2esJ6--MhWIVt04pyKE2PvstqYGBnUTTIq9zCJujcRjP_xNYMfKCTTr_mklkSRnTV1WTL4dhs29e57faYKjhvUu6zNTt_84EdsIuC5CHFQnfQK0YsXSB6uk_rprb8CRcO-DgkjmtqqC9EvEiLhq5z1HAMTTM18PcUbH4w6rfR-BYbugOz_SfBn9rE5uOPOUhZfMJkrAcX53x0e0yf0JDocoqjO2n2-GT-aqNxNWO2ov6ZKlXOQjjWssN-j3fYy64BpkdlAO9BmJ2zvnreUKFrtEAQ%3D%3D)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=38c9bc916f974b0b8d649374a740eb3a&_e=Uvw4YEF3Xyf4wbdk4zbiJ_5iXikFqx71ulcyhdHFXZ4Ma0Sc72kmK1-Ocdjt3bQZtbHyDaTAbSnHxBnUrfyqk33fITixhcJ4fFlGz062VHErORWC5bvgrAdPXTbapEwNSVtbwHzh0XDgSsOl6z0o8pYYtqWEG5tjJw35X3Qc8YyD7REUGBMwebOorH0tbOngyRI8HeSQYGsOV0kpUWsbzw5BdkQEgjXtn-oSk-c2EOI0omSee2JlQnXa-1YHru9KmXTrQauUo1HSfyp14NUoxvkQeQ3mpirPv0RZOdZ5QXpb3GoFCsVXCvMhAQKoq9o8r77el_EawNn9tHlZadR6PGmLupShAqxMgYC5aXYNa5hnwbT4sMuO3-gYXzx17vbPEn8gFz1IgpdV9Rw-jEuvBjVWYmrKx84UOAsPGUa2h7qjyrP9uVPtiy3CtL9SGkC6DKz1-w9Mfk_WYU1ov6I6rCCOC3Q1VxhA-HpDIp_ozO5LfhxKQ5Tsm9RY2JADGnz4cLnE9FKgiz1faxNd6IVR7q6HQSwzZA6r8UrJ-QLRaihvnknK1iNA4vpbXE4GBjz3BPwmf7bu3m_GzwcJ4nNXOmQRm1uUJnBK6T2zqCFr5SnH0sp9Od708FxV_3yX87HonU0fXZd2KxpEkPbxH6YZcE1b95HnlR7cd_N_nLPCM-idkcuUhIsgcuEEi3UmO9uLeDc6OkCkuHlFI1jl_RhEPw%3D%3D)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=38c9bc916f974b0b8d649374a740eb3a&_e=Uvw4YEF3Xyf4wbdk4zbiJ_5iXikFqx71ulcyhdHFXZ4Ma0Sc72kmK1-Ocdjt3bQZtbHyDaTAbSnHxBnUrfyqk33fITixhcJ4fFlGz062VHErORWC5bvgrAdPXTbapEwNSVtbwHzh0XDgSsOl6z0o8pYYtqWEG5tjJw35X3Qc8YyD7REUGBMwebOorH0tbOngyRI8HeSQYGsOV0kpUWsbzw5BdkQEgjXtn-oSk-c2EOI0omSee2JlQnXa-1YHru9KHcNTaEcU-ahIsP9i1oHW0i0GgCEu5EMj_YzWC7BfO4Z-i62PCfLBErqQTYJSY8B2laMQfiMY98HsH0cpjP_zRDMLmPmXUarVSYK6nvBEdBBh4tGs5xg53kSZf28qozbgHLKFYxFB5uD3UpGFi1Xp9XYTeSyloRadgepg-q6NgjIt3k5UYzhm5Es6-kM1LIBWUALl8LQ4dXXu0VOiZAlwJU9x9F9cCU639IEREtiL-6Ws7uPJBF-67fCPXHMLPuiR90bELMxX907q0zdXGabxNiYel3n_1inyMwuEyB2u-zIpxnw4-1nbdPsKbvOzUToynynzM__yG57XbD6qVjugglODTUfGZx1XX5j8hCmZUugpgrMl9W4fDJPq6O3fNeVAF8VeLp500hV5LxrozUznpV5fqSwNtF7tGFL980bVYbX_sXoeMzaKQ8qw5H7bAPlzGFROWB_M0c6d96HeAivcgw%3D%3D)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

Learn how your state's tax policies stack up -- and get a free copy of Facts & Figures when you donate today. | Patriot, State tax policies can have a major influence on where people choose to live, work, and build their futures. Unfortunately, most people don't know how their state's tax policies compare with those of other states. Does your state have a high tax rate? Which states are the worst? Which states are the best? Is there another state that is better for you? Don 't worry, Patriot, Tax Foundation does this research so you don't have to. Tax Foundation is a nonpartisan research organization that has been providing rigorous, trusted tax analysis for more than 80 years. Our mission is to improve lives through tax policies that lead to greater economic growth and opportunity. By providing you with timely, high-quality research and analysis, we can give you the information you need to take advantage of tax opportunities. Plus, when you donate any amount today, we 'll send you a free copy of Facts and Figures to compare each state's tax collections! Facts and Figures is a resource Tax Foundation has provided to US taxpayers and legislators since 1941. In the introduction, we explained, " There is need for concise and accurate data. Facts give a broader perspective; facts dissipate predilections and prejudices. . .[and] this collection of data is an important step to meet the challenge presented by the broad problems of public finance. " Our current version builds on eight decades of tradition and still serves as a one-stop state tax data resource that compares all 50 states on over 40 measures of tax rates, collections, burdens, and more. So even when the tax code isn 't simple, understanding it is. There is a reason our team of trusted experts is routinely relied upon for presentations, testimony, and media appearances on tax issues spanning every level of government. Derek –
I'm asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. Our country has been propelled into another war of choice in the Middle East. The job market is shifting beneath our feet.
And the president doesn’t seem to have a plan. He doesn’t even seem to care. And his administration is in over its head.
But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. We've got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:
🏥 It's time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.
💾 We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we've got to ensure we don't have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.
🇺🇸 We've got to stand up for America's critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.
⚡ We've got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy.
🏠 We got to address the housing crisis by encouraging rehabilitation of existing structures, speeding up permitting, and making it easier for first-time homebuyers to obtain their first mortgage.
The path forward will not be easy but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.
I'm going to campaign this year – as I always have – by getting out on the road, talking to voters face-to-face, telling them about my record, and most importantly showing them what I'll do if I get rehired.
And the next few weeks will be hugely consequential to the outcome of November’s election. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.
A donation made today is an investment in the future we’re building together – and it truly couldn’t come at a more important time for our campaign or our country.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.

I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

Did you see this new poll, Peter?
I’ve been getting pummeled by attack ads in Alaska – and this poll shows that those attacks are working. My lead is nearly HALF of what it was earlier this year. We can’t let it fall any farther.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260602-partner-mp.ZU-Odo&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-724&t=2&akid=724%2E34582%2EdhJM4D)

Here’s the reality, Peter:
We can’t look at a few good polls and decide we can sit on the sidelines. In fact, it means we need to push harder.
My opponent and his dark money backers see these polls, and they’re panicking. They realize that we have what it takes to win this Senate seat, so they’re pouring money into attack ads to try and stop us.
To fight back, we need to hit each and every one of our fundraising goals. We’re coming up fast on our second quarter deadline, and we’re tracking behind... so we need to raise a little bit more today to make up that difference.
That’s why we need a huge number of donations today. I’m counting on those of you who understand the importance of this race for Alaska and the entire country to make a donation today before it’s too late. So I’m personally asking:
[**Will you split a donation between Small Town PAC and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Alaska? No matter how much you can afford to chip in today, it all adds up when lots of us are chipping in.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260602-partner-mp.ZU-Odo&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-724&t=4&akid=724%2E34582%2EdhJM4D)

As long as we all work together, we will win Alaska’s U.S. Senate seat.
The strength of this campaign has always come from regular people stepping up when it counted. And it means a lot to me that so many of you have faith in our ability to win. Together, we’re building a movement.
Thanks for being a part of it, Peter.
\- Mary

Friend, In my community of Southeastern Michigan, our households pay some of the highest energy rates in the country while receiving some of the worst service. The utility monopoly DTE Energy consistently raises its rates to enrich its shareholders, instead of updating urgently needed infrastructure. Earlier this year, **DTE Energy was fined $100 million for poisoning our air and violating the Clean Air Act. A federal judge actually found that they saved $70 million by breaking the law. What was DTE’s response? To ask for another $474 million from our pockets** , on top of the $242 million rate increase the corporation just got. **Utilities should not be poisoning our air and water. If they do, they should be held accountable and forced to pay a real price.** That’s why I’ve introduced the **_Make DTE Pay Act_** , which would double Clean Air Act penalties on investor-owned utilities that request a rate hike within two years of a pollution penalty. Corporate polluters like DTE treat violating our environmental protection laws as the cost of doing business. We need to change that math and make polluting our communities as bad for business as it is for our health. ****[**Add your name today as a grassroots co-sponsor of my _Make DTE Pay Act_ and hold greedy, polluting corporations accountable to our communities.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmwH56BiZUa8B4InAnYjFsD9SOcPz4HE978ZnTfc8cO7CKIkRsvfShYGNHWycz1ZUATD9ewqAlHWlQJlYL9IBTFio98btbqgUXw64-zGaW6gm4CpT1rdUGmVRu8v2hbGeehBWtFmYbS62ukNvoRwy0SJa7wKIvAyKLZQm8knPPHhAYIz4D1IUfgN47EUNqWbR04x9biktkrjsRtTz2w1Pggb5Wq-qxBpxaBAglvcUivUooxok92DZVbW3aQSbxboXgySvjqbKlrknko8Xq8QVi3kzaj6LsuurOfGJDmHn_Ykv717QMsNrs-OODWlHFMGG-YarTrTUzJTALau9YqC5XfjieE1ObskYNgFb3VgK0FFLa6NPp6jxSdetk7Xl1fyk3oPLjuq0rA82rX7kP9k5E59O9TuqfT3Kc3cgYAlWfo8hrN3Pkf81rgLtLSmIr4ZfWCTlAxVD_qbxnQPUvHPFWy-hdlmqg21V85uLk6Bf_Wku2RWF8gNAY1Y-Z0y0_S-io__x13UbsCPu5gTT7ZR0PpQ/4r5/oRbNY6rNQoq0PcRtLMsZAQ/h1/h001.P7Oz9l-k_JfWiDRGsQcOM7Sev0BsW6hjogoGWwD4He8)**** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmwH56BiZUa8B4InAnYjFsD9SOcPz4HE978ZnTfc8cO7CKIkRsvfShYGNHWycz1ZUATD9ewqAlHWlQJlYL9IBTFio98btbqgUXw64-zGaW6gmHPe1SQpCiXf93oD0bkWqGXhxftv1_Fh9BAfpjtDPztSjzDw_e0XZK0JFBRYuByIzO6MuLZ4q1cUqrauLm7Pybua_G4kFvZ0ECgzMS4H9blSeJQUU1WjnBopqydGuZxa28ypUIm3yOIEklW8h9eeIXPVvuCCSwZAXbpAmlLO51OOwkBfYeOfxsFA4E66KPMzt7OEpypuEBrQ-RrCSh_wJB8yUg4ou-pD0FX4wzU4-x4xuE7qnMVJnBb0XFQUw5859wb2c0JHHQXg1lOgHfDBWTvulX6KDrJxQMawqlMiCMwJlCQZCHaYWG4-rp8Nnhp-c_oOPvVkArS9qwSdN9AGaceQwcucKJMKQ57bK8nETiUhiaED87J7J7qMt6ovqehTRevpxfARYfETZcc03uRgImMImPxEb2quv8sh607sFgSA/4r5/oRbNY6rNQoq0PcRtLMsZAQ/h2/h001.A8y1AxRvGbmovY6LBNOinyglp1LUbnOg43URFkwR0PM)

Utilities such as electricity, water, and heat are a human right. For years I’ve been pushing to end utility shutoffs, make utilities public and not for profit, cancel utility debt, and help families pay their utility bills. I’m also holding corporate polluters accountable, including DTE.
**How does DTE get away with poisoning our air while price-gouging customers?** In 2024 DTE donated to 120 out of 148 state lawmakers through shadow political committees. Over the years, the corporation has donated millions of dollars to protect itself from accountability.
So I’m supporting state policies and a ballot initiative to ban utilities from interfering in our political system. And I’m fighting money in politics at the federal level. I recently co-sponsored the _Lowering Utility Bills Act_ to help communities across the country afford rising costs and ensure access to life-saving utilities.
I grew up in the shadows of corporate polluters where we have the highest rates of asthma in the country. That’s what drove me to become an environmental justice advocate many years ago, and it’s why I helped co-found the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus in Congress―to protect our right to clean air and water, and protect our communities from greedy corporate polluters that put their financial bottom line over our health.

Together we’ll continue building a society where everyone can access clean air and water, affordable energy, and other rights such as quality healthcare and housing.

Always serving you,
Rashida

body:

You’re probably getting a lot of political texts right now as part of the GOP Majority’s effort to confirm likely voters for the midterm elections.

| Peter,
On Friday, Louisiana's MAGA-occupied state legislature passed a new congressional map designed to eliminate a majority-Black district and hand MAGA another seat in Congress and without skipping a beat extremists are already calling for an updated map to eliminate our last remaining majority-Black seats.
They canceled an ongoing Congressional primary to jam through this map--a first in American history. It was a direct result of SCOTUS gutting the Voting Rights Act, a deliberate attempt to turn back the clock to Jim Crow in the Deep South. They thought that would break our spirit and that Democrats and Black voters would just give up.
But they thought wrong. On May 16th, Black voters turned out in record numbers and delivered a blow MAGA never saw coming. Bill Cassidy became the first sitting senator in over a decade to lose a primary. Every single one of Governor Landry's amendments went down by 20 points or more.
It was a win so shocking that legendary political operative James Carville declared Dems now have a fighting chance to flip our senate seat blue.

City by city. Parish by parish. A grassroots blue wave built from the ground up.
Because of Democrats across the nation standing with us when all seemed lost, we turned the May 16th election, which could've been our undoing, into a historic win with record turnout. Now we're building for November, and we need you with us again:

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 2, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**LETLOW EARNS ENDORSEMENT OF TERREBONNE PARISH REPUBLICAN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE** _Growing support from grassroots conservatives across Louisiana highlights continued momentum in U.S. Senate runoff_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed conservative candidate for U.S. Senate, announced that she has earned the endorsement of the Terrebonne Parish Republican Executive Committee (RPEC).
The Terrebonne Parish RPEC voted to endorse Letlow after reviewing the candidates in the race and recognizing her proven conservative record, commitment to Louisiana families, and strong support for President Trump's America First agenda.
_"Julia Letlow has consistently demonstrated the conservative leadership Louisiana needs in the United States Senate,"_ **said Terrebonne Parish RPEC Chairman Reggie Billiot.**_"Terrebonne Parish is at the heart of Louisiana's energy industry, and we need a senator who will fight for our workers, our businesses, and our way of life. Julia has a strong record of supporting Louisiana energy and will work alongside President Trump to unleash American energy dominance. We're proud to endorse her campaign and help send her to the Senate."_
_"I am honored to have the support of the Terrebonne Parish Republican Executive Committee,"_**said Congresswoman Letlow.**_"Terrebonne Parish is home to generations of hardworking men and women who have helped power Louisiana and our nation. As Louisiana's next senator, I will continue fighting to unleash American energy, protect the jobs that drive our economy, and stand with President Trump to advance an America First agenda that puts Louisiana workers and families first."_
The endorsement adds to the growing coalition of Republican leaders, grassroots activists, and conservative organizations supporting Letlow's campaign to bring strong America First leadership to the United States Senate.
As a member of Congress, Letlow has fought for Louisiana families, championed the Parents' Bill of Rights, supported law enforcement, defended Louisiana's energy industry, and worked to deliver critical resources to communities across the state.
The Louisiana Republican primary runoff election will be held on June 27.

_**by Ellie Leonard, Blue Amp Media Contributing Editor**_
On May 6th, Howard Lutnick gave a [closed-door deposition](https://substack.com/redirect/b149530b-4e18-42bb-991a-61055482baca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before the House Oversight Committee. And while a long list of prominent figures gave video-recorded depositions--including President Bill Clinton and Secretary Hillary Clinton, Leslie Wexner, and Ghislaine Maxwell--Lutnick and the "Majority" refused to allow his deposition to be videotaped for the American people, leaving out the ability to judge his body language, alleged profuse sweating, and nervous fidgeting.
* _**Congresswoman Ansari:** Would you be open to having this on video?_
* _**Howard Lutnick:** I'd prefer to just answer questions about my three meaningless and inconsequential meetings as briefly as possible._

Those words, "meaningless" and "inconsequential," occurred 18 and 21 times, respectively, in the deposition. So did "inexplicable" (6), "no recollection" (8), "speculate/speculating" (16), "one and done" (6), "that's my story" (3), and "no" (751). It was an exercise in semantics in which Lutnick, "the man, me, I," juggled his answers in a way so performative that even the interviewers sounded confused and frustrated, which was probably the point. He often paused to clarify the definition of "I" as "Howard Lutnick," or "as a man," or "I, we, me, _the_ Howard Lutnick," lest we forget (maybe because we don't have video) who was speaking.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Epstein's house on the left, Lutnick's house on the right
Howard Lutnick bought the home next door to Jeffrey Epstein in 1997, and spent the next 8 years renovating the "derelict" mansion filled with "pigeons and mice." It wouldn't be until 2005 that his family moved into the building that shared a wall with Epstein's now infamous Upper Eastside townhouse, purchased from an entity known as the "Comet Trust." Lutnick claims to remember only a single seller, Charles de Gunzburg. But de Gunzburg's family transferred the deed from Epstein in 1996, who had transferred it from the SAM Conversion Corp. (run by Leslie Wexner) in 1992, who had purchased it in 1988. And as with most Wexner/Epstein properties, there is no searchable record of sale for 11 East 71st in Lutnick's name.

Later that year, Lutnick and his wife had their first ("virtually non-existent") interaction with Epstein, a knock on the door from an unknown assistant, and an invite for coffee. In Lutnick's recollection, they sipped for 15 minutes, were offered a tour, discovered a massage table in the middle of what they thought was the dining room, inquired, and were so disgusted by Epstein's answer that they left, never to return again.
> #### _"...and I said, 'How often do you have a massage?' And he said...'Every day and the right kind of massage.' And he said it to me, and my wife is standing next to me, and we looked at each other, and we left." \- Howard Lutnick_
Lutnick launched into another long diatribe about who "we" is, and what "I" means, ultimately ending with "I, Howard Lutnick, would not have a personal or professional relationship with this person," clarifying several times over that this was to mean "business, social, or philanthropic." He repeats this several times throughout the interview. However, now we know he had all three.
Lutnick emphasizes the lack of interactions or knowledge about Epstein's personal/criminal history, yet in October of 2025 he had far more opinions about what he thought went on inside Epstein's home. In the interview with the New York Post's "Pod Force One," Lutnick said he assumed everything in that massage room was caught on video, and that the videos were ultimately "traded" for Epstein's notorious sweetheart deal, in which he received only 13 months of jail time, including 72 hours/week of work release. Lutnick would later retract these statements, saying he was speculating, and that he really didn't mean what he said when he claimed Epstein was the "greatest blackmailer ever."
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[](https://substack.com/redirect/3174d9f7-8505-4498-a6ac-bd6c8704dae1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At the time of Pod Force One, Lutnick hadn't seen the files, and claimed his visit to Epstein's home was really the only interaction they'd had. But on January 30th, 2026, the DOJ released 3.5 million files, including proof that Lutnick had had a much closer relationship with Epstein than he'd originally claimed, including a trip to the island with his children. In a long thread of emails that began with scheduling, we can read Lutnick's wife's excited planning with Lesley Groff, asking where to park the boat as she traveled with her family from St. Thomas to Little St. James. Howard emphasized that they would be bringing a big group, including eight children, four adults, and four nannies.
> #### _" I have another couple with me on my boat, and each of us has 4 children-two 16's, two 14's, a 13, a 12, an 11, and a 7-year old. Thanks, Howard."_
Incidentally, the other couple was Michael and Marcy Lehrman, whom Lutnick knew through Cantor Fitzgerald, where Mr. Lehrman worked as the global head of real estate. Lehrman had tried to buy Epstein's house in 2009, a deal that quickly fell through.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

There is little known about the trip to the island, other than pictures of Lutnick on an overlook with his children and Epstein, the emails, and Lutnick's description of a "brief, meaningless, and inconsequential lunch" that he claimed was only for an hour, and that they didn't go inside any of the buildings.
> #### _" We sat outside, had lunch. It was boring. We left." \- Howard Lutnick_
Ten months later, one of the nannies would send her resume to Epstein's accountant, Richard Kahn, who was attempting arrange an interview between the nanny, Emily Dawson, and Epstein, and a man named "Peter." It is not known whether the interview happened, and Lutnick claimed not to have knowledge of it, nor did he know if this nanny was one of the nannies from the island.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lutnick would later testify to this before the Senate Appropriations Committee, again, claiming little knowledge of anything.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0d07e7c4-2d38-4684-a6c1-c82715913bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Lutnick continued to say he had limited interactions with Epstein over the 14 years they were neighbors, bolstered by the fact that both wealthy men used assistants for all email and phone correspondence. So if Lutnick wanted to say he never saw something, read something, or heard something, he could easily point to the fact that the email came from Lesley Groff (who he says he has no knowledge of), and was sent to his assistant Matthew Gilbert. Sure, they came from Howard's email address, but he rarely did his own work. So how would he know what was said? An easy out.
He mentions a conversation about scaffolding that the men had in person on the sidewalk. Epstein would be doing work on the house; he wanted Lutnick to know it would be annoying. Another time the men corresponded about sending their lawyers after the nearby Frick Museum, which threatened to block their view of the park with a remodel. Lesley scheduled drinks. Phone calls went back and forth. And history is none the wiser.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
But in late 2012, a new tech advertising firm called "Adfin Solutions" launched its first stock purchase agreement, which included several investors. Two of those investors were Howard Lutnick and Jeffrey Epstein. Epstein invested nearly $900,000 into the company, owning 4.29% and over a million shares under the heading of the "Southern Trust LLC." Lutnick, however, says it was not he himself who invested in Adfin Solutions, but Cantor Fitzgerald, and claimed no knowledge that Epstein was involved. Their signatures are one page apart, and the Southern Trust is listed many times in the sales documents.
* _**Jack Emmer:** Okay. So this is, from its title page, appears to be a stock purchase agreement or a series A preferred stock purchase agreement for a company named AdFin Solutions, dated December 28, 2012. At the back of the document, Bates numbers ending in 9580 and 9581, we find Mr. Epstein, as well as yourself, as signatories to the agreement. When this agreement was signed in December of 2012, did you know that Mr. Epstein was also a signatory to the agreement?_
* _**Howard Lutnick:** No._

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But according to documents found in the Epstein Files, the two men were still talking about their investments in Adfin, with Lutnick encouraging Epstein that "this is their year." Adfin officially went out of business by 2023.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d785f330-7a4f-4201-a92d-6947088e5b67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Five years later, Epstein donated $50,000 to a United Jewish Appeal Federation dinner honoring Howard, which included a ten-seat table and the opportunity to write a glowing blurb. Epstein did not attend, nor did he write anything.

Peter, As mayor, I don’t just talk about making government work — I deliver. My team took a city with a junk-bond credit rating and turned it around. We cut red tape, slashed unnecessary fees, and made it easier to get shovels in the ground. That’s how we built a thousand new homes, issued 10,000 building permits, and took down blighted structures so families and small businesses could thrive again. **That’s what real infrastructure work looks like. ** The roads and bridges that connect our communities are more than just infrastructure; they're a lifeline for economic advancement and safety. That’s what we’ve been building in Scranton — and it’s exactly what I want to fight for across NEPA in Congress. But to make more progress, we need leaders ready to cut red tape and drive federal investment in NEPA. Meanwhile, our opponent has been busy trading stocks and looking out for himself instead of investing in the roads, bridges, and passenger rail systems our communities need. Fellow Conservative,

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a proud Minnesota native, combat veteran, and former Navy SEAL. **This past weekend, I won the Republican Party’s endorsement for the United States Senate.**

I joined the Marines after 9/11 and fought in the brutal Battle of Najaf in Iraq. I later became a Navy SEAL, deploying nine times to 70 countries in defense of this nation. _**I’ve lived service and sacrifice — and I’ve seen what happens when politicians put their own power over the American people.**_

I have watched Minnesota Governor Tim Walz abandon Minneapolis as riots destroyed a Target near my sister’s home.

I watched on as liberal activists stormed the streets of Minnesota with disregard for fellow citizens, law enforcement, or political opposition.
**
That moment changed everything. I knew I had to step up and fight for our state and our country.

**
For the past year, I’ve been hitting the ground every single day — attending local Republican events and meetings, listening to Minnesotans, and earning the trust of the grassroots._**That hard work paid off. After a hard-fought convention in Duluth, Minnesota, I won the Republican Party of Minnesota's endorsement.**_

As my momentum has grown, my opponents have started coming after me _**hard**_. Even after the delegates made their choice, my now primary opponent has decided to ignore grassroots, not honor the endorsement and run against me in the August primary anyway.

**Here’s what’s at stake:** In the last 60 years, there has _**never**_ been a Republican U.S. Senate nominee in Minnesota who did not first win the party’s endorsement. This victory puts us on the strongest possible path forward.

I’m a Christian, a combat-proven veteran, and a fighter who puts America First — secure borders, strong national defense, election integrity, and protecting life. I’m not a career politician. I’m the outsider who has actually served this country in uniform.

clean_body: I've lived service and sacrifice — and I've seen what happens when politicians put their own power over the American people. | Fellow Conservative, My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a proud Minnesota native, combat veteran, and former Navy SEAL. This past weekend, I won the Republican Party’s endorsement for the United States Senate. I joined the Marines after 9/11 and fought in the brutal Battle of Najaf in Iraq. I later became a Navy SEAL, deploying nine times to 70 countries in defense of this nation. I’ve lived service and sacrifice — and I’ve seen what happens when politicians put their own power over the American people. I have watched Minnesota Governor Tim Walz abandon Minneapolis as riots destroyed a Target near my sister’s home. I watched on as liberal activists stormed the streets of Minnesota with disregard for fellow citizens, law enforcement, or political opposition. That moment changed everything. I knew I had to step up and fight for our state and our country. For the past year, I’ve been hitting the ground every single day — attending local Republican events and meetings, listening to Minnesotans, and earning the trust of the grassroots.That hard work paid off. After a hard-fought convention in Duluth, Minnesota, I won the Republican Party of Minnesota's endorsement. As my momentum has grown, my opponents have started coming after me hard. Even after the delegates made their choice, my now primary opponent has decided to ignore grassroots, not honor the endorsement and run against me in the August primary anyway. Here’s what’s at stake: In the last 60 years, there has never been a Republican U.S. Senate nominee in Minnesota who did not first win the party’s endorsement. This victory puts us on the strongest possible path forward. I’m a Christian, a combat-proven veteran, and a fighter who puts America First — secure borders, strong national defense, election integrity, and protecting life. I’m not a career politician. I’m the outsider who has actually served this country in uniform. But I can’t do this without you. With the primary ahead, will help us defeat Tafoya in August, fuel our ground game, and build the momentum we need to defeat Tim Walz’s Lt. Governor Peggy Flannagan this fall! Will you stand with me today? Thank you for believing in this fight. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America. body:
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing.

For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.
| | | | | |
---
[ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkL2q3TAQhJ9G7mwk-e-kcBE4uLspQiClWa9WlriyZFbrXO7bhxOSB0g7Mwwz38-37Q1iivn4BictLH7jutVAH1CFwfuI7-R84WF08Fk3q-3U6qnV9pUzjVscOjDY0GLmhx768TGZJizjaHZvNVpE1GSNcXowBCMgTuh208TlVaUnba3p9filG4yeYZ5hcvsD4OHVoCERS8d03XuKCFmgvvvCSB2Ws0lLELmq6r8quyq7upJBqJNAgbhQ9YXDfUKO8tkVPpRdM0gsGVIrDDHHfLRIWYjbBHfG0NZQWLarvcql-pUJb-aYD9U_hW9Sdrrl3ARV__z-Y7XtvwN_DSxZKIvqn3RCTKbhxV0fMaVYp1kN-nipf5bL_3P-tdjfAQAA___RhY7S)
---
Friend,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkL2q3TAQhJ9G7mwk-e-kcBE4uLspQiClWa9WlriyZFbrXO7bhxOSB0g7Mwwz38-37Q1iivn4BictLH7jutVAH1CFwfuI7-R84WF08Fk3q-3U6qnV9pUzjVscOjDY0GLmhx768TGZJizjaHZvNVpE1GSNcXowBCMgTuh208TlVaUnba3p9filG4yeYZ5hcvsD4OHVoCERS8d03XuKCFmgvvvCSB2Ws0lLELmq6r8quyq7upJBqJNAgbhQ9YXDfUKO8tkVPpRdM0gsGVIrDDHHfLRIWYjbBHfG0NZQWLarvcql-pUJb-aYD9U_hW9Sdrrl3ARV__z-Y7XtvwN_DSxZKIvqn3RCTKbhxV0fMaVYp1kN-nipf5bL_3P-tdjfAQAA___RhY7S)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkL2q3TAQhJ9G7mwk-e-kcBE4uLspQiClWa9WlriyZFbrXO7bhxOSB0g7Mwwz38-37Q1iivn4BictLH7jutVAH1CFwfuI7-R84WF08Fk3q-3U6qnV9pUzjVscOjDY0GLmhx768TGZJizjaHZvNVpE1GSNcXowBCMgTuh208TlVaUnba3p9filG4yeYZ5hcvsD4OHVoCERS8d03XuKCFmgvvvCSB2Ws0lLELmq6r8quyq7upJBqJNAgbhQ9YXDfUKO8tkVPpRdM0gsGVIrDDHHfLRIWYjbBHfG0NZQWLarvcql-pUJb-aYD9U_hW9Sdrrl3ARV__z-Y7XtvwN_DSxZKIvqn3RCTKbhxV0fMaVYp1kN-nipf5bL_3P-tdjfAQAA___RhY7S)

---
**Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._
Respectfully submitted,
Dennis Price
Founder & CEO
Heroes for Humanity

Hi friends, I have a favor to ask:
**[Will you endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan?](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b58515-2149-40ae-aab9-8136fe2f5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Add Your Name](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b58515-2149-40ae-aab9-8136fe2f5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I know you might be thinking: _Does that even matter? What does an endorsement even mean?_
So before you click away, let me tell you why endorsements are so important in a race like this one.
The truth is, Michigan is a true battleground. The GOP is spending tens of millions of dollars to turn this state red because they know Senate control will come down to what happens here.
**Yes, we need financial resources to fight back. But the real power is our people.**
This is a true grassroots campaign, and we need to know who is truly with us. That's what an endorsement can do.
And if you are reading this and you're still on the fence, great! I'm glad you're here, and I'm determined to earn your support.
But if you've been following this campaign for a while, if you've been reading these Substacks, and if you know what I'm about, **[then I'm asking you to endorse me today.](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b58515-2149-40ae-aab9-8136fe2f5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Democracy is not a spectator sport, and endorsements are a way to make your voice heard. Because when you endorse, you're saying three things:
**I believe in Haley.
I believe she can win.
I believe she will deliver results for Michiganders.**
It's an honor to have people say that.
That's why it means so much to me to have the support of so many leaders I deeply respect, including:
**Jennifer Granholm** , Former Michigan Governor
**Debbie Stabenow** , Former U.S. Senator from Michigan
**Nancy Pelosi** , Speaker Emerita of the U.S. House of Representatives
**Chris Coons** , U.S. Senator from Delaware
**Catherine Cortez Masto** , U.S. Senator from Nevada
**Lauren Underwood** , U.S. Representative from Illinois
**Brenda Lawrence** , Former U.S. Representative from Michigan
**Joe Tate** , Former Speaker of the Michigan House of Representatives
**Dave Bing** , NBA Hall of Famer and Former Mayor of Detroit
**Jim Blanchard** , Former Governor of Michigan
**Martin O 'Malley**, Former Governor of Maryland
**Lavora Barnes** , Former Chair of the Michigan Democratic Party
**Over a dozen Michigan Mayors**
**14 members of the Congressional Black Caucus**
**12 union endorsements so far** - twice as many as any of my opponents
When I look at that list, I think: We must be doing something right.
These folks are not adding their names for fun. They are adding their names because they believe that I'm who I say I am: a fighter for the working families of Michigan.
That's why the endorsements that mean the most to me are the ones from the thousands of regular folks who have said, "I'm with you, Haley."
Grocery clerks.
Nurses.
Teachers.
Students.
Retirees.
Small-business owners.
Working parents.
People who are busting their tails every single day just to get by. People who are tired of scraping by. People who are ready for something better.
That's who I'm in this for. Because what I hear in those endorsements is hope.
Hope that Michiganders can have a brighter future.
Hope that the government can actually make people's lives better.
Hope that the leadership in Washington can actually fight for working families, manufacturing, lower costs, health care, clean water, and communities that have been pushed aside for too long.
That is what I'm trying to build here.
**[If you're with me, will you endorse my campaign today? It takes just a few seconds (we timed it). But it matters.](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b58515-2149-40ae-aab9-8136fe2f5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Endorse Haley](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b58515-2149-40ae-aab9-8136fe2f5bae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for being here.
More soon.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

---
| | Dear Peter,
We organized two successful volunteer events in Renton and the Rainier Valley last week where we talked to hundreds of people in the district about our campaign's demands and Kshama's record of winning historic working-class victories!
The day started with us meeting at Columbia Park and Pratt Park where we held simultaneous two rallies and experienced canvassers offered a quick training. After going over responses to common questions and the horrific plans by four big tech companies to build five “hyperscale” data centers in King County, we hit the streets at multiple locations in Renton and South Seattle. Working people around the country are angry about the massive pollution, energy and water costs, and other damaging impacts of these huge data centers. The working people we spoke with were excited to hear about our upcoming June 7th town hall at the Sullivan Center in Tukwila and our strategy to fight back against these data centers and the AI-related mass layoffs.
Workers Strike Back members recently took part in a successful battle in Pekin, IL, where our movement defeated a hyperscale data center there. They shared their experience at the recent national Zoom meeting about how they were able to defeat Big Tech. Kshama Sawant and other activists will share the lessons of this victory at our upcoming town hall so that we can build successful movements here in King County.
There is mass anger at both warmongering parties of the billionaires. My main opponent, Adam Smith, is the #1 Democrat on the political payroll of Palantir, the corporation that profits from the use of AI in war and bloodshed. Smith has taken money from Palantir’s billionaires & multimillionaires Joe Lonsdale, Alexander Karp, Akash Jain, & Mehdi Alhassani.
Kshama is the only candidate in this race with a record of fighting back against the billionaires and winning. Kshama led the movement that defeated Jeff Bezos to win the Amazon Tax in Seattle, which funds hundreds of millions of dollars for affordable housing annually.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | All across the Rainier Valley, we’ve been finding people who are excited about our campaign and have donated and are volunteering. They see that Kshama’s the only candidate in this race fighting for the working class with real demands, and a strategy to win them. To elect the first ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress, we need everyone who supports what we're fighting for to donate and volunteer! We need YOU to get involved!
---
|
---
| | Workers in the tech industry are facing wave after wave of mass layoffs at the same time that the executives and wealthy shareholders are making money hand over fist. Artists, actors, and writers are seeing the billionaires and multimillionaires use AI technology to try to destroy their livelihoods and co-opt their work and images. Workers in multiple industries are under attack by AI and the hyperscale data centers. The huge strain these data centers put on local infrastructure and on the environment will be devastating if allowed to continue.
On top of that, Democratic and Republican State Legislatures and City Councils are giving huge tax handouts for building the data centers to the same billionaires who are profiting from them. These tax handouts mean working people pay more in taxes, after already suffering from deeply regressive tax systems.
Both the Democrats and Republicans have sold out to Big Tech, which helps bankroll their campaigns, including Adam Smith.
We have a historic opportunity to elect a proven fighter and independent socialist, Kshama Sawant, to the U.S. Congress. Kshama is fighting for a living-wage jobs guarantee in addition to fighting to stop these massive data centers and AI layoffs.
---
|
---
| | There are only 9 weeks left before the primary, and we need you to get involved! We’re going all out to get Kshama elected, and June will be critical to preparing the ground for our mass Get Out the Vote campaign in July.
Join us in fighting to win free healthcare paid for by taxing the rich, shutting down ICE and the detention centers, to end all military aid to Israel, for national rent control, and to stop the data centers and AI layoffs. Come out and join us at our upcoming June 7th town hall and sign up on the website now to help us build for it!

| | Thank you to everyone who came out to this volunteer day, we’ll see you again soon!
In solidarity,Kshama for Congress

name: Voto Latino
subject: Latino voters in TX-35 are paying attention
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Republicans gerrymandered this district, but that won’t stop us.
#
Peter,
**Last month, Texas Republicans won their long battle to gerrymander congressional maps. Now, Texas’s 35th Congressional District is one of the seats they’re hoping to flip because of it.**
**[If you’re ready to fight back with voter registration and turnout in Texas, chip in $3 right now to power Voto Latino’s work in battleground districts like TX-35.](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260602-1-ak.5HxqVQ&amount=3&refcode=em20260602-203&t=1&akid=203%2E1366028%2EvBywww)**
Let us explain why we’re going all in on this district:
Right now, TX-35 is represented by a Democrat. But if the district had been redrawn in 2024, it would have gone to Donald Trump by about 10 points. That’s exactly why Republicans redrew their maps — because they know that manipulating districts helps them hold onto power.
**In last week’s election, Republicans picked Carlos De La Cruz, a Trump-backed loyalist who has been clear that he will be another Trump enabler in Washington.**
Democrats nominated Johnny Garcia, a Bexar County Sheriff’s Deputy who’s focused on the everyday issues families are feeling right now, like the rising cost of groceries and struggling to pay utility bills.
Garcia has talked about ending Trump’s cost-raising tariffs, preventing members of Congress from stock trading, and bringing money back to the community he’ll serve.
Latino voters in this district are paying attention, and turnout will change the outcome even in districts Republicans tried to rig. But only if we make sure voters make it to the polls in November.
That’s why we’re doing what we do best in Texas right now. We’re registering eligible Latino voters and organizing on the ground to motivate people to vote in this important election.
[**If you want to help us meet this moment in TX-35 and across Texas, will you chip in $3 today to power Voto Latino’s voter registration and turnout work?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260602-1-ak.5HxqVQ&amount=3&refcode=em20260602-203&t=2&akid=203%2E1366028%2EvBywww)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260602-1-ak.5HxqVQ&amount=3&refcode=20260602-203&t=21&akid=203%2E1366028%2EvBywww)**
Thank you,
Voto Latino

subject: A hotel and a bit of compassion
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Matt Schultz for Alaska

| | Peter, A few years ago, Anchorage's main homeless shelter closed. It instantly made life harder for hundreds of people who were already struggling to get by. Instead of waiting around for someone else to help out, my congregation and I got right to work. Teaming up with local businesses, nonprofits, the municipality, and the federal government, we bought a hotel and turned it into permanent workforce housing, allowing hundreds of people to have a place to lock up their belongings in the morning, go to work, and come home to a safe, stable environment at night. And it worked. It was economically wise, it was wise from a health perspective, and it helped boost our economy. **Most importantly, it was just the right thing to do, and it was an example of what good can be done when our government acts with compassion and conscience.** After over two decades as a pastor, I've learned that one of the best ways to help someone is to help change the situation and policies that caused their hardship in the first place. **That's why I'm running for Congress.** Alaskans are losing their food security, their health care, and their jobs, and our congressman, Nick Begich, has been a rubber stamp for the agenda causing it. **_We can and must do better._** I've been traveling across Alaska listening to people and talking about the issues that matter most to them. We need a representative who actually shows up and governs for _every Alaskan_ , not just the billionaires and corporate special interests. Hey Peter,
The Supreme Court’s latest attacks on voting rights should anger every single one of us.
MAGA Republicans are making it crystal clear what they are trying to do: silence Black voters, weaken our communities, and rig district lines so they never have to answer to the people.
We’re already seeing it happen in Tennessee, with their GOP rushing to eliminate the state’s only Black Congressional District following the SCOTUS ruling.... And if extremists in Missouri get the chance, they will absolutely come for St. Louis next.
That’s why this moment matters so much. We need Dems willing to fight back against this blatant attack on our voting rights, pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act , and exercise all options available to stand up for the right to vote.
My primary is just shy of 2 months away. We need resources right now to keep organizing, reaching voters, and building the grassroots power it takes to get us into Congress so we can fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q2?refcode=x_260602_VRA_act]

Cori

name: LeftNet
subject: We’re looking for your input
body:
Take our Summer Priorities Survey
#
It’s officially June, which means we’re just five months away from Election Day.
The days start warming up, and so does the fight ahead. More people are tuning in, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what matters most to you.
So we’re kicking off the summer with a quick priorities survey.
**[Will you take a minute to tell us what you want to see LeftNet focus on between now and November?](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260602-1647&t=1&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)**
**[Take The Summer Priorities Survey](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260602-1647&t=2&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)**
Whether it’s confronting the climate crisis with the urgency it demands, organizing against ICE, defending democracy, taking on corporate greed, or protecting reproductive rights — we know the stakes are high, and there’s a lot competing for attention.
But we’re not just collecting responses and moving on. We want our work from now til November to reflect the priorities and values of the people who power this movement, and that starts with hearing directly from you.
Your responses help shape our messaging, the organizations we ask you to support, issues we elevate, and the fights we take on next.
Whether you joined our movement last week or you’ve been with us for a long time, your voice matters here. [**So please take a moment to tell us what’s on your mind!**](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/summer-priorities-survey/?source=em20260602-1647&t=3&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)
Thanks for taking the time to fill out this survey!
— LeftNet

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**
---
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.leftnet.org/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=4&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.leftnet.org/signup/update_your_information/?t=5&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.leftnet.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=6&akid=1647%2E2118727%2E7h1hdv)

Email us: [team@leftnet.org](mailto:team@leftnet.org)

name: Tabitha Isner
subject: The AL GOP ended my campaign
body:
Thank you all for the tremendous support –– please keep the momentum going for November!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c1f4cdfc3e53/im-running-for-alabamas-most-flippable-state-senate-seat-in-15-years-13693945?e=62156fa6a8)

| | | | | | **I didn’t end my campaign. The Alabama GOP ended my campaign.**
**They did so by cancelling an election that was already underway. It’s devastating for me and for you. I can't thank you enough for pouring your prayers, money, and time into this campaign. But the real devastation is for the voters who showed up to cast their ballot only to have their ballot ignored. The real devastation is for the Black voters who are once again packed into Senate District 26 and denied representation in Senate District 25. The fight for Voting Rights continues, and I'm in it for the long haul. I hope you are too.**
_Confused by all this? Read the longer explanation below:_
Back in 2021, Alabama put in place new maps, as is standard after a census. Plaintiffs in Alabama sued over the maps, claiming they were racially gerrymandered. There were two different cases: one about Congressional districts, and one about State Senate districts. Both of these cases were won by the plaintiffs and new maps were put in place in 2023 for Congress and in 2025 for State Senate.
Under the old map, SD26 is 66% Black and the Democrat is expected to win with at least 75% of the vote. SD25 is just 29% Black and safely Republican. The court found that this was a racial gerrymander and that Black voters were entitled to two seats in the Montgomery area, or at least one safe seat and one "opportunity district."
When the courts finally settled on the NEW map in late 2025, that new map made SD25 safely Democratic and made SD26 a toss-up. Thus, the two incumbents chose to swap districts so that each of them could run in the seat where they had the best chance of winning. The Democratic Incumbent Kirk Hatcher moved to SD25 and the Republican Incumbent Will Barfoot moved to SD26. That gave me the opening to run against Barfoot in 26 to flip the seat. (Again, the court drew the map to make 26 winnable by a Democrat)
The State of Alabama had appealed this decision, but the Court said that the state was required to use the new map until that appeal was settled.
Then the Louisiana vs. Callais decision came down from the Supreme Court, undermining the Voting Rights Act and impacting redistricting cases in a number of states including Alabama. While the media’s attention has been rightfully focused on Alabama’s Congressional maps, the State of Alabama was pressing for permission to change the State Senate map too.
On Thursday, the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that the state of Alabama can utilize its old map while the court considers the State's appeal. As a result, on Friday morning, Governor Ivey announced that the results of the May Primary were voided. As of that moment, I was no longer the Democratic Nominee for Senate District 26. The old map, the map that was deemed a racial gerrymander by the Federal District Court just six months ago, was put back in place and a new Primary Election was called for August 11th.
Just as we expected, the incumbents have switched back to their original districts. There is no longer a competitive seat for me to run in. If I were to keep running, I'd be running in a primary against Kirk Hatcher to represent SD26.
While I do want to serve in the State Senate, I did not get into this to run against a Democrat. So I am ending my campaign. I am heartbroken for myself and for the Democrats of Alabama who deserve more than 8 Democrats in the State Senate, and for the Black voters who will once again be packed into SD26 and denied representation in SD25.
I will still be working my tail off to fight for democracy and for Democrats to win where they can in Alabama, but there is no longer a seat I could run for in good conscience.
So where do we go from here?
I will be endorsing Kirk Hatcher for Senate District 26. Kirk and I have spoken and we will be working together to turn out Montgomery Democrats in November. Together, we will be continuing the Super Voter Initiative. Hatcher’s campaign will even be hiring some of our staff. I hope you will join me in seeing 2026 as the year we do big things together in Alabama.
– Tabitha

Hey folks,
I just finished digging into a story that honestly left me with more questions than answers.
Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner are moving forward with a massive luxury island project in the Mediterranean, and the deeper I looked, the stranger it got. This isn't some harmless real estate venture. It's a billion-dollar development tied to political power, foreign governments, and a family that has spent years convincing us the rules don't apply to them.
This one gets personal. It gets uncomfortable. And it raises questions that a lot of people in the media seem unwilling to ask:
* [**00:01:07**] Ivanka tells the story of "discovering" the island during a swim -- and I explain why that version of events doesn't add up.
* [**00:03:33**] We break down the island's history, its military past, and the special treatment the project is reportedly receiving from Albanian officials.
* [**00:05:18**] I connect the dots between wealth, power, and the growing sense that elites are building a world completely separate from everyone else.
* [**00:08:49**] Ivanka describes the project as something that's "not even a business" -- and I react to just how disconnected that sounds from the realities most Americans face.
* [**00:14:22**] We zoom out to the bigger issue: accountability, corruption, and why so many powerful people seem convinced they'll never face consequences.

This video is about far more than one island. It's about a political and economic system that increasingly feels rigged for the people at the very top. Whether you agree with every conclusion or not, the questions surrounding this project deserve scrutiny, and the public deserves answers. If you value independent reporting that isn't afraid to challenge powerful people, help me keep doing this work.

--Mike

Derek,

Infectious diseases are on the rise globally, and Ebola has been labeled a Global Health Emergency. _And how is the Trump administration responding?_
With a total failure of leadership.
**RFK Jr., a guy with no medical training and a junk-science agenda, has spent his time as health secretary blowing up the public health system from the inside:**

As the damage to the global economy continues to mount, their desperation appears increasingly evident.

### **Cracks in the armor**
By now, western voters have recognized a familiar pattern pervading the war on Iran: claims from Washington about an imminent threat that never ultimately materialized, statements about supposed [progress](https://substack.com/redirect/4a07f9fd-af8e-4dd1-94a2-3407531dbbbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the battlefield belied by [facts](https://substack.com/redirect/c5b8fdcf-0a55-4e31-9206-004e4efcbd87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) verified by independent sources, repeated [claims](https://substack.com/redirect/944a3497-13e2-4f14-8d0a-be8a150d62de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about a durable agreement to end hostilities falling on the shoals of Israeli [belligerence](https://substack.com/redirect/7057f963-6690-4683-aeba-46ebad5505b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and mounting [damage](https://substack.com/redirect/a00378b5-79f0-401c-a26d-6db83e8cf3c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a global economy reliant on fossil fuel shipments that will remain dramatically curtailed as long as Iran continues to resist Washington's belligerence.
Washington needs to reach a deal with Tehran more than Tehran needs to reach a deal with Washington. Having succeeded only at [entrenching](https://substack.com/redirect/68a3e961-2255-4dd4-af26-5e1855749b93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the theocracy that Trump & Netanyahu thought they could dismantle through a haphazard bombing campaign, they are now scrambling to re-open the Strait of Hormuz before the escalating energy crisis [fully impacts](https://substack.com/redirect/a9a4a1bb-36bc-4ee0-96d1-b827d3f1264e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the American economy.
That's why administration officials appear increasingly clueless. Having admitted that the war was initiated at Netanyahu's behest, Secretary of State Marco Rubio [claimed today](https://substack.com/redirect/23449f30-dc58-4050-bee9-b1e2c8b62ffe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that a deal is imminent--even as Iran has [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/2367a20e-b439-42dd-984f-2ffc5b349a19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it has left the negotiating table due to Israel's refusal to respect the preceding ceasefire.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/37a1a09f-b43f-48de-bf7e-e5e55394ca34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Perhaps incensed by the growing recognition that Israel played him like a fool, the president is grasping at straws, reportedly [yelling](https://substack.com/redirect/f2d0f3e1-d541-4f57-a165-e035d4f52f71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at Netanyahu yesterday in an [expletive-laden rant](https://substack.com/redirect/015d794f-a5b2-49f3-8d20-99b55de36c67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that definitely, absolutely, really does (I _mean_ it!) sound like the composed articulation of coherent thoughts by a calm leader.
Between Trump and Rubio, it's as if Washington officials are if standing in the middle of the street with their pants around their ankles as a truck barrels down the road towards them with no brakes.
Not only are administration officials publicly confirming the confusion that [defined](https://substack.com/redirect/130c9ebb-9d3e-4612-afd1-ca4f84ea8951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their assault from the very beginning, but Iran continues to win the battle for hearts & minds that Trump & Netanyahu abandoned in favor of [repeated](https://substack.com/redirect/90b83c81-b499-4042-9899-bec09476852c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) market manipulation. The latest [lego videos](https://substack.com/redirect/7dd50329-7236-4f5c-b369-863af7918b18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) posted to support Tehran have continued to deliver viral, blistering attacks on not only Trump and Netanyahu, but the [broader project](https://substack.com/redirect/c503c7f0-18e1-4699-bbaf-e306c1b09458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of neo-imperialism in which they are complicit.
Whether due to Iranian lego videos or his own willingness to [ignore](https://substack.com/redirect/43c2e171-0bf0-49d8-953f-2e8676ec8e72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the economic suffering of his own base, Trump's approval ratings have been taking a sustained [nosedive](https://substack.com/redirect/fe57f8bb-3e7f-4e99-99fb-b3671b61058a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
As a likely result, the president appears to be stepping back from the most unapologetic versions of his renowned corruption. Just today, reports emerged that a previously announced $1.8 billion slush fund (which was supposed to be part of a [settlement](https://substack.com/redirect/8d61ab71-dc1e-40fe-ae54-2a23385da70b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a lawsuit that Trump initiated against the IRS) has been [scrapped](https://substack.com/redirect/2d07068c-a9e3-40c3-9548-4631e59d3c85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
_If you 've learned something from my writing, don't stop now! **Subscriptions are free** , while paid subscriptions support--and help expand--my work holding corruption accountable._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..6CIl_21shq5rb4urpD6D3K7LdKdW63dQMnJU8reMKys?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=200367322)
### **A rare chance for something good to happen**
Throughout this article, I've referred to "Washington" rather than "Trump" because reducing the war and its various machinations to the acts of an individual president would indulge the bipartisan fascist duopoly that [placed](https://substack.com/redirect/a2a1fa77-de5e-41dd-aa98-e7741f28d489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) him in office, [enabled](https://substack.com/redirect/07cd693c-ad47-4a88-8e53-d6b8e3a52126?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his constitutional crimes, and [continues](https://substack.com/redirect/a352e824-6177-40fa-8420-39a7ba5d35df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to enable his right-wing agenda. Rather than allow the misimpression that replacing the president could meaningfully shift the institutional agenda shared across Washington, I intend to lay blame at the feet of everyone responsible--including the Democratic Party.
Democrats whine about Trump after having long paved his path, while braying about a crisis in democracy in which they remain demonstrably complicit.
Today is election day for the primary election in California. Make sure all your friends here know about their options--including the candidate who doesn't appear on the ballot (and wasn't allowed to participate in debates) because Democrats fought to exclude him.

subject: TAKE ACTION: Keep Big Oil out of the Arctic Refuge!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3NTk2MDgS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ4MDAyMDI3MQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell Big Oil: Hands Off the Arctic Refuge

URGENT: This Friday, the Trump administration is holding a lease sale for oil and gas drilling in
the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. The environmental movement must take action TODAY, before companies bid on
leases in this irreplaceable landscape. Tell Big Oil: Do not bid on the Arctic
Refuge!

The Arctic Refuge should be protected, not sold off to the highest bidder for oil and gas drilling. Decades of
leadership from the Gwich'in people and sustained pressure from people like you
have kept oil companies out of the Arctic Refuge, and it’s crucial that they stay out.

Tell Big Oil today: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge leases! Not now, not ever. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec- ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, We cannot let Big Oil companies destroy the irreplaceable Arctic Refuge with oil
and gas drilling. For decades, the Gwich'in people have led the movement to keep
the Arctic Refuge free from corporate greed and extraction — no drilling, no
development. But that could all change this week. The Trump administration is holding a lease
sale this Friday, June 5th and Big Oil companies need to hear us loud and clear: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge
leases! Add your voice today and urge Big Oil to stay out of the Arctic Refuge. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/DzpWMVrqZ- Congressional Republicans enacted a law that mandates lease sales for the
Refuge, but nothing requires oil companies to participate — and so far, the
environmental movement has been able to hold the line to keep Big Oil out. We need to remind major oil companies that drilling in the Refuge is financially
risky, publicly unpopular, and incompatible with a rapidly changing Arctic. In
2019, BP pulled out of the Arctic and Alaska completely, signaling the clear risks for drilling. On top of that, not a single bidder
showed up in the most recent lease sale in 2025. Let’s keep the pressure up! LCV stands with the Gwich’in people and opposes lease sales on their sacred
lands, and in the entire region. If Arctic Refuge drilling were to occur, it
would have disastrous consequences for Indigenous communities, including the
Gwich'in people, as well as for our climate. The Arctic Refuge has endured decades of political attacks. It has survived
because Indigenous-led movements and people like you refuse to let oil companies
turn this region — essential for our shared human, animal, and environmental
well-being — into another oil and gas graveyard. Nothing justifies selling off one of the last wild places on earth. Join LCV in sending a clear message so oil companies stay out of the Arctic Refuge — take action today >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/2zZrMNLYg- Thank you for standing with LCV and with all the protectors of the Arctic Refuge
— so that this irreplaceable wilderness may continue to thrive for future
generations. America Fitzpatrick
Conservation Program Director
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Decades of leadership from the Gwich'in people and sustained pressure from people like you have kept oil companies out of the Arctic Refuge, and it’s crucial that they stay out. Tell Big Oil today: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge leases! Not now, not ever. ADD YOUR NAME Peter, We cannot let Big Oil companies destroy the irreplaceable Arctic Refuge with oil and gas drilling. For decades, the Gwich'in people have led the movement to keep the Arctic Refuge free from corporate greed and extraction — no drilling, no development. But that could all change this week. The Trump administration is holding a lease sale this Friday, June 5th and Big Oil companies need to hear us loud and clear: Do not bid on Arctic Refuge leases! Add your voice today and urge Big Oil to stay out of the Arctic Refuge. Congressional Republicans enacted a law that mandates lease sales for the Refuge, but nothing requires oil companies to participate — and so far, the environmental movement has been able to hold the line to keep Big Oil out. We need to remind major oil companies that drilling in the Refuge is financially risky, publicly unpopular, and incompatible with a rapidly changing Arctic. In 2019, BP pulled out of the Arctic and Alaska completely, signaling the clear risks for drilling. On top of that, not a single bidder showed up in the most recent lease sale in 2025. Let’s keep the pressure up! LCV stands with the Gwich’in people and opposes lease sales on their sacred lands, and in the entire region. If Arctic Refuge drilling were to occur, it would have disastrous consequences for Indigenous communities, including the Gwich'in people, as well as for our climate. The Arctic Refuge has endured decades of political attacks. It has survived because Indigenous-led movements and people like you refuse to let oil companies turn this region — essential for our shared human, animal, and environmental well-being — into another oil and gas graveyard. Nothing justifies selling off one of the last wild places on earth. Join LCV in sending a clear message so oil companies stay out of the Arctic Refuge — take action today >> Thank you for standing with LCV and with all the protectors of the Arctic Refuge — so that this irreplaceable wilderness may continue to thrive for future generations. America Fitzpatrick Conservation Program Director League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. ✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**

Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche revealed that the Department of Justice discovered a room packed with documents from former special counsel Jack Smith's investigation into Donald Trump. Blanche added that the documents were found in "burn bags," which are typically used to destroy sensitive documents for security purposes. He said while it’s not uncommon to use these types of bags to get rid of sensitive information, where it was left led him to believe an "honorable" agent may have been trying to preserve it.
