He said while it’s not uncommon to use these types of bags to get rid of sensitive information, where it was left led him to believe an "honorable" agent may have been trying to preserve it. | | | Background Notes from Judicial Watch | Source: Judicial Watch | Jan 21, 2026 Judicial Watch sued the Department of Justice for the emails of former Special Counsel Jack Smith with officials in Georgia and New York and with the White House, congressional and law enforcement offices regarding his investigation into President-elect Donald Trump. | Source: Judicial Watch | Mar 20, 2026 In July 2025, Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Chuck Grassley issued a press release titled “Clinton Campaign Plan to Falsely Tie Trump to Russia and FBI’s Failure to Investigate” concerning additional Comey-era events. Grassley made public the formerly Classified Appendix (“Durham annex”) to John Durham’s 2023 Special Counsel report. | Source: Judicial Watch | Jun 30, 2025 Judicial Watch filed a lawsuit against Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes for her communications with former Special Counsel Jack Smith. “Collusion against President Trump by Democratic politicians with Jack Smith and the weaponized Biden Justice Department are of great public interest,” Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton said. | | | | FOLLOW US | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- ---|---|---|---|---|---|---|--- | Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St SW Ste 800, Washington, DC 20024 | © 2026 | |

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260602-6305-footer&t=1001&akid=6305%2E420207%2EGDcYva ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

Enrollment in the Affordable Care Act is down. Significantly.

It’s no coincidence this came after MAGA Republicans allowed our health
care subsidies to expire – all so they could fund giant tax breaks for
billionaires instead:

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260602-2.YnAppi&refcode=em20260602-6305&t=1002&akid=6305%2E420207%2EGDcYva ]A headline from the Washington Post that reads 'Millions expected to
lose Affordable Care Act coverage as costs spike. Congress's refusal to
continue pandemic-era subsidies for ACA beneficiaries is taking a big bite
out of consumers' pocketbooks.'

This is a deliberate moral failure — and we predicted it from the very
beginning. Pramila was fighting hard alongside House Democrats to keep the
focus on expiring subsidies at the beginning of this year, and Republicans
were feeling the pressure. But then Trump launched new wars in Venezuela
and Iran, and the distraction worked.

When Trump and his MAGA Republican cronies are in power they take a
wrecking ball to working family programs while stuffing their billionaire
donor’s pockets.

That’s why it’s critical we pass Medicare For All and guarantee
comprehensive health coverage for every person in this country, from birth
through death.

Pramila has introduced the Medicare For All Act in every single session
since she was elected. But in order to make it happen, we need to grow our
progressive movement and elect a majority coalition strong enough to fight
back against the insurance industry and Big Pharma.

That’s where you come in — Pramila doesn’t take a dime from corporate PACs
or lobbyists. This campaign is funded by grassroots supporters like you
pitching in $5, $10, $25 at a time to fuel our fight to guarantee health
care as a right for every American.

The counties in our district shifted an average of 33 points to the left over four years. The primary results show that the numbers are still trending our way.
**We can win this.**
Our campaign keeps gaining momentum because people believe in our message, and we're out on the trail making sure they hear it.
We're showing up, and Dan Meuser isn't. He never has. He's failed at his job and he's failed us for far too long. It's about to catch up with him in November.

| To all Cait Conley supporters. 💪 Please. Don’t click away from this short but important email. We know we’ve been sending a lot of fundraising emails – and you deserve an explanation about why.

Army combat veteran Cait Conley is running against Mike Lawler to flip NY-17, one of only three districts nationwide that split their vote for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress. Polling shows that Cait is the strongest candidate to take on Lawler and win.
---

NY-17 is going to be one of the closest, most expensive races in the country. So it’s important for our campaign that we don’t just meet our fundraising goals – we can crush them. Every. Single. One. If everyone who got this email chipped in just $17 or $10, we’d be on track to hit our goals and fight back against the GOP's dark money.

But the truth is, not everyone will donate. Most won’t. We’re hoping you’re different. Our ability to flip this district and elect a proven fighter depends on the 1% of people willing to lean in and demand better from this moment.

Peter, Andy Ogles is at it again. What he posted earlier today has no place in our politics. This kind of rhetoric not only divides people, but it also puts people, including Tennesseans, in harm's way.

He’s already deleted it, but we have the receipts. And deleting a tweet does not undo the harm of posting it in the first place. **This is who Andy Ogles is: an online troll, not a Congressman.

clean_body: I'm writing because I'd be proud to have you with us as we close this out strong today — and start getting ready for the fight that comes next. | Fellow Conservative, It's Election Day — and I'm feeling good about where we stand. In fact, I have some incredible news to share: President Trump has officially endorsed our campaign. Take a look — I'm both humbled and honored to have the President's support, but it's because of people like you , the early support, the belief in what we're building, the work that got us here — it all led to this moment. I'm not writing you in a panic. Because here's the truth: the moment this primary is behind us, the real battle begins. The radical left has made it clear they'll spend whatever it takes to flip seats like this one and ram their agenda through. I won't let that happen — but I can't meet them dollar-for-dollar without conservatives like you in my corner now. Keeping the Republican Senate majority this year is the top priority. | A win is one thing. body:

Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $5 or whatever you can to Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260602-10514&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10514%2E614464%2EX8qkps)**

Chris is up just one point. One. 45-44. **That is a tied race.** And while the whole country is staring at Georgia and North Carolina, New Hampshire is sitting there in a dead heat with nobody riding to the rescue.
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**
Chris Pappas is the only guy who can win this seat. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to bring people together. But he cannot — _cannot_ — do this alone when every check is being written and every eyeball is looking somewhere else.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution split between Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee today. $10, $25, $5, whatever you can spare. Because if we let this seat slip away while everybody’s watching Georgia, we’re gonna wake up in November and wonder how the hell we let it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260602-10514&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=10514%2E614464%2EX8qkps)**
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire _is_ the map. You hold this seat, and Democrats have a real path to the majority. You lose it, and it doesn’t matter what happens in North Carolina, Texas, Maine, or anywhere else.
Don’t let New Hampshire be the reason we come up one seat short.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104443?refcode=em20260602-10514&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=10514%2E614464%2EX8qkps)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: How is John Thune doing as Majority Leader?
body:
A short survey. Tell me what you really think.
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/0100019e8ab4805e-86ffc112-a26b-4248-a838-401c5487a188-000000/dHDnkb7usP6BDhn5-6_dGefJM0LAKeZt40ZCfSRkIZs=452)Patriot–You and I work hard to send the right people to Washington. So here is a question worth asking out loud: is the man now running the United States Senate doing the job we need him to do?Senate Majority Leader John Thune sets the agenda for the entire chamber. He decides which bills reach the floor, which nominees get a vote, and which fights get picked. That makes his leadership one of the biggest factors in whether our priorities move forward or stall: election integrity, spending restraint, a secure border.I want to know what you think. Not the pundits. Not the consultants. You.**Here is what I am asking:** Please take 90 seconds to [_**fill out this short survey**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSe6seDfwxeAw2jR4M_7dFbnZZdnjlwHnN2qV4i8oRXTQec6lw%2Fviewform/1/0100019e8ab4805e-86ffc112-a26b-4248-a838-401c5487a188-000000/6b0_DysJtLcbZcioEEzClKHa_cEQTsWPky5ut1_SHVs=452) and tell me how you believe Senator Thune is performing as Majority Leader.[COMPLETE MY SURVEY](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSe6seDfwxeAw2jR4M_7dFbnZZdnjlwHnN2qV4i8oRXTQec6lw%2Fviewform/2/0100019e8ab4805e-86ffc112-a26b-4248-a838-401c5487a188-000000/IHsWY8X7CIqXibBD2xGBI5o7Q0-beF-aqS6X3FiyJpU=452)With the South Dakota Republican convention at the end of this month, your read on his leadership is timely. I am gathering supporter sentiment now so I can speak clearly about where the grassroots actually stand.Your answers go straight into how I prioritize our work in the weeks ahead. The more of you who respond, the louder that signal is.In liberty,Jenny Beth Martin

# JOIN LILY
to
OFFICIALLY FILE FOR U.S. CONGRESS

Dear friends, volunteers, and supporters,

I will officially file my candidacy for the U.S. House of Representatives, New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District June 4th, 2026.

We _plan to meet at 12pm_ on the steps of State House Capitol Building Thursday June 4th, 2026

107 North Main Street, Concord, NH 03301

Signs will be provided.

We will then proceed inside to meet Secretary of State David Scanlan in his Office at 12:30pm where I will officially sign up!

I chose June 4th to file for office because it is the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square Massacre in China. This sober day highlights my personal emigration journey to the United States, and ongoing fight for freedom here at home and around the world.

37 years ago, an estimated 10,000 peaceful protesters across Beijing and more than 200 other cities nationwide were murdered by the CCP military. These victims were labeled as “Counter-Revolutionaries”, their cases sealed and Chinese words such as "June 4th",and "Tiananmen Massacre" are still banned today on the Internet in China.

In 2024, I won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against now incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in over a decade to flipping NH-02. I am back and running stronger than ever in 2026. This will be an exciting grassroots campaign.

Please help me win to keep America and New Hampshire free.

[Donate Here](https://us.list-manage.com/1BLhmv5jCxd?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

For Freedom,

Lily Tang Williams

Friend, it’s Rob O’Neill, a Navy SEAL and proud American.

I was part of the heroic team that put Osama bin Laden in a body bag. Our pilots, aircrew, intel, QRF, and air support put it all on the line to accomplish the mission.

**In every fiber of my being, I am built to serve this country, and I will do whatever it takes to ensure America is safe and full of opportunity. **

What I have to say is for those committed to keeping America great. I am counting on you to rise to the occasion and fight for our country.

Pulte Named Acting Intel Chief

President Trump on Tuesday [tapped Bill Pulte](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OrDAMhZ8mdEGJB5ihSHEburntlsgkBqwxAZGw7OOv4BHWhZsjfefn692_kYXj9B8Xcnse-7CGPu_HskVcKEU6OWYSPzONaevBQKNNow30UXpbBBd8QOsLcvb5MtV1dTG71rQtAGIbbDPYymJoxgqrB9rwagdTF-wulGkMwKOujC1xeBEaX3sAG4b6qSqDQnsud9qOQdhjzJg-47p7Kv26FOLmnLekHv8UdAq68zxL_OE1XaqC7uIr6Mz9QEF3t9KRTh0i64FF9HZIJj2vR-I4acwZ_UeHdSp2F7aTRTg1V5JpQZbbNf9hpG8HvwEAAP__F_J18A) to serve as acting Director of National Intelligence, replacing Tulsi Gabbard, who announced she would leave the post by month's end. Pulte runs the Federal Housing Finance Agency, where he built a reputation as a [MAGA enforcer](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGStCAQhJ8GMyyYFTQh-BOz_dMLLYRxd-pGoJA9X_9KH-EmmKirv-7-ei5PT0zp9d_v6Grblpjj0upnL8nveCQ8KTXk8CbcjrKAAiuVlQqWxIvuoosheh06dHqc1HCd6d5OjXYKJsIEgJOxdnvYyVpl9AjD4PXWkbuslFUADzMo3ft1Qq-CCQA6rmYUg_KMtfUVy2dlCj41f3xvuQbsQ947du_WyiEe_wTMAubzPPuSmRqFfAkEzAnPQ8B8kQTM6n4gYF6JWZYPN5SRKoaWq8ybTL5RTp7lXZmpqy6Wk5jpsFee1-6Jb3b7w1Q_Dn4DAAD__yzjd2I) who deployed the agency's platform to target political opponents rather than oversee housing finance. His acting appointment sidesteps Senate confirmation. Pulte has no intelligence community background. Whether Trump formally nominates him remains unclear, and [some Senate Republicans](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2O6zAMhE9jdwok-r9Q8Zp0ee2WBkXRjrC0LEjK5voL5wjLjhhgZr75eqwPDBLi_h8Ptrluqz_9WvPrSBEPLpHfIVYWegbeSlpBw6j0qDSsUVbTeuvJo6GWrZlm3V83tE87dVPHoOeFjCfddZNDb5ho7tGzmaAN9rLSowbohl6bG7qZUdNAAMa7YWp6jcK53jKnl5NAGCuW7-3MxDc6j1bss9ZUmu5fA_cG7pgiv8slXU-ugYQbuH9YVHpJZbWjc5i9iljDGVHUh03CzpFYwWw2PzpclqXN1qd3EAllvJrsBwb5pNY_jPRj4TcAAP__mGR4Ig) are expected to balk at elevating a housing regulator to the nation's top spy post. ★★★
Trump Signs Narrowed AI Order

President Trump [signed an executive order](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO5CAQRL8GZ7aaNsbjgOASZ3PphRYD7ZnWYbCAWaT9-pXnE7aDjkr1qurffbtbDhyff-1BJtd988lvNb-PM9qDSqTGsVJwL6a9nBsC6h50D7jFsMnOG--8la4jI-cbqOum7mXcIjUpp_dxggVgls7qEXeQjsjOSnVsLivQgDhOCuRgHzey4CaHKP1jmoUCGyjXIdP5fgR2NlZb_u8pOxpcOrpgXrWeRYx_BK4C19bacKbAlV26BALXSK0IXC-SwBU-DwWun3594WcsvU8tFv4m31vuU_aUe4BF6fG2dNn4s3EIXPSV53lYDh92_cVUXwZ_AgAA__-N-na1) Tuesday directing AI companies to voluntarily submit frontier models for government testing 30 days before public release -- a scaled-back version of a broader regulatory push that collapsed under industry pressure. AI czar David Sacks secured the shorter window and voluntary framework after [industry objections](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OqzAQhZ_GdKDx8BNSuLgNXW67JRp7hmCtbZBxwj7-ijzCTjHNkb5P53w95gf54NPzP0UxuSwzbzyX_Ip7oihHktOnIsGtXpZjnxFwqGGoAecUZl2xYcekXSVG30boruur1dx70D0tWnetjENL9m5bsZoXhtEuzJU3FwoGQGz7DnRDdhQC1ztEzba_qQ4oSC5Nlv1lg3eUCh3fy5adNG6LVTBrKfuh2n8KJ4XTeZ6NS9ZdocLpwiuc4PNQ4fQpVcuPuFfxb6m3zJJr8s1aYqiy4f30IfhjuNTPSD58NOUPq7wN_gYAAP__28ZxCQ) sank an earlier, more prescriptive draft. The order explicitly bars mandatory licensing or preclearance requirements for AI development. Critics on both flanks are skeptical. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

clean_body: This is the part most people don’t see | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it.
